bohairic_examples.translation: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲉϫⲉⲁⲡⲁ ⲉⲩⲁⲅⲣⲓ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲉⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉϥϭⲓⲕⲁϯ ⲛⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲁϥⲛⲁϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲛⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲟⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲓⲉ ϫⲉⲟⲩⲛ ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲁⲣⲝⲛⲣⲱⲙⲓⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ ϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲓⲉ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲕⲁϯ ⲉϥϫⲏⲕ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛϩⲱⲃ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲙⲉⲧⲣⲱⲙⲓ ϣⲁⲧⲉⲛⲫⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲙⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧϥ ⲙⲙⲟⲛ ϣϫⲟⲙ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲥⲱⲙⲁ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ....... ⲉⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙⲕⲁϯ ⲓⲥϫⲉ ⲇⲉ ⲙⲡⲉϥϭⲓ ⲛⲛⲁⲓ ⲓⲉ ⲉⲩⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲉⲫⲗⲏⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲛⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲡⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲁⲧϣⲓⲃϯ ⲡⲓⲙⲟⲛⲟⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ ⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲛⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲉⲙⲕⲁϯ ⲛⲉⲙϩⲱⲃ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲙⲉⲧⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲭⲱⲣⲓⲥ ⲫⲛⲟⲃⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Apa Evagrius said: ‘If He had not accepted the human spirit, He would not have taken on human flesh; for the Blessed Virgin Mary did not bear one without a human soul. In every human work, free from sin, this was fitting. For it is not possible that there be a body [….] soul and spirit. For unless He had received these, Christ would be called in vain. Therefore, the immutable Word, the Only-Begotten Son of the Father, assumed a human body, as well as a soul, spirit, and all things human, without sin.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯⲛⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓⲉⲁϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲉⲡϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲉⲁϥⲭⲱ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲏⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϯ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲉⲃⲓⲁⲓⲕ ⲙⲡⲓⲉⲣϣⲓϣⲓ ⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲙⲡⲉϥϩⲱⲃ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϩⲟⲛϩⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲉⲙⲛⲟⲩⲧ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲉϥⲣⲱⲓⲥ
bohairic_examples.translation: It is like a man, traveling to another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲩⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲁϥϩⲟⲛϩⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲟⲧⲟⲩ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲟⲩϣⲧⲉⲙⲥⲁϫⲓ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛϩⲗⲓ ⲙⲡⲉⲧⲁⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲉⲃⲏⲗ ⲛⲧⲉⲡϣⲏⲣⲓⲙⲫⲣⲱⲙⲓⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ .
bohairic_examples.translation: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϩⲱⲥⲧⲉ ⲙⲡⲉⲛⲑⲣⲉϩⲗⲓ ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲟϥϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓⲉⲛⲭⲁⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉ
bohairic_examples.translation: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲇⲉⲛϫⲉⲉⲫⲣⲱⲛⲛⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ
bohairic_examples.translation: But Ephron answered Abraam, saying,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲭⲁⲧ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛⲡⲁⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲑⲟⲙⲥⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲁⲓⲟϯ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲙϩⲁⲩ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲓⲟϩⲓⲛⲧⲉⲉⲫⲣⲱⲛⲡⲓⲭⲉⲧⲧⲉⲟⲥ
bohairic_examples.translation: And he said to them, I am added to my people; ye shall bury me with my fathers in the cave, which is in the field of Ephron the Chettite,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲟⲗϥ ⲉⲡⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲭⲁⲛⲁⲁⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲑⲟⲙⲥϥ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲙϩⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲟⲓ ⲛⲇⲓⲡⲗⲟⲩⲛ ⲡⲓⲙϩⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲁϥϣⲟⲡϥ ⲛϫⲉⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲕⲧⲏⲥⲓⲥ ⲛⲉⲙϩⲁⲩ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥⲛⲉⲫⲣⲱⲛⲡⲓⲭⲉⲧⲧⲉⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟ ⲙⲙⲁⲙⲃⲣⲏ
bohairic_examples.translation: So his sons carried him up into the land of Chanaan, and buried him in the double cave, which cave Abraam bought for possession of a burying place, of Ephrom the Chettite, before Mambre.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϩⲟⲛϩⲉⲛ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲙⲏϣ ϩⲓⲛⲁⲛⲥⲉⲣⲱⲧⲉⲃϩⲓϫⲉⲛⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁϥϭⲓ ⲙⲡⲓⲍ ⲛⲱⲓⲕ ⲁϥϣⲉⲡϩⲙⲟⲧ ⲁϥⲫⲁϣⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϯ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲭⲱ ϧⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲭⲱ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛⲡⲓⲙⲏϣ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲭⲏ ϧⲉⲛⲃⲏⲑⲁⲛⲓⲁ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲏⲓ ⲛⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲡⲓⲕⲁⲕⲥⲉϩⲧⲉϥⲣⲱⲧⲉⲃⲁⲥⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩⲥϩⲓⲙⲓ ⲉⲣⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲟⲕⲓ ⲛⲥⲟϫⲉⲛ ⲛⲛⲁⲣⲇⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲟⲧⲥ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲧⲓⲕⲏ ⲉⲛⲁϣⲉ ⲛⲥⲟⲩⲉⲛϥ ⲉⲁⲥϧⲟⲙϧⲉⲙ ⲙⲡⲓⲙⲟⲕⲓ ⲉⲁⲥϫⲟϣϥ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲧⲉϥⲁⲫⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard--very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁⲡϩⲏⲧ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲙⲕⲁϩ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲛⲓⲁⲛⲁⲩϣ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏⲉⲑⲣⲟⲧⲉⲃⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲉϥⲟϫⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn't wish to refuse her.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉⲙϩⲁⲛϣⲁⲣ ⲛⲱⲓⲗⲓⲉⲩⲑⲣⲉϣⲣⲱϣⲛⲉⲙϩⲁⲛϣⲁⲣ ⲛϩⲩⲁⲕⲓⲛⲑⲓⲛⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙϩⲁⲛϣⲉ ⲛⲁⲧⲉⲣϩⲟⲗⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: and rams' skins dyed red, and skins dyed blue, and incorruptible wood,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲣⲱϣⲓⲉϫⲱⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲇⲓⲕⲉⲟⲥⲩⲛⲏ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲑⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲕⲁⲓⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉⲕⲁⲗⲟⲩ ⲛϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲁϣⲃⲱⲧ ⲁⲓⲉⲣϫⲓⲛⲓⲟⲣ ⲙⲡⲓⲓⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲓϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲙⲡⲁⲣⲉⲙⲃⲟⲗⲏ ⲃϯ
bohairic_examples.translation: Let there be to me a sufficiency of all the justice and all the truth which thou hast wrought with thy servant; for with this my staff I passed over this Jordan, and now I am become two camps.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩⲙⲡⲉⲥⲣⲁϣϥⲛϫⲉϯϫⲓⲛⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉϯⲁⲣⲉⲧⲏ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲁⲡⲟⲥⲧⲟⲗⲟⲥ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁϥϭⲓϣϣⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲟⲛ ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲕⲉⲙⲟⲣⲫⲏ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲟⲩⲥⲙⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲟⲩϫⲓⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲛⲉⲙⲧⲟⲩⲡⲟⲗⲏⲧⲓⲁ .
bohairic_examples.translation: for he did not merely content himself with hearing about the external virtues of the apostles but desired also to see their appearance, reputation, life, and instruction—

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲧⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲛⲁⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲁⲗⲟⲩⲁϥⲣⲁϣⲓⲉⲙⲁϣⲱ ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲁⲩⲧⲱⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲃ ϩⲓⲟⲩⲥⲟⲡ ⲁⲩⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲟⲩⲉⲣⲏⲩ ⲉⲩⲉⲣⲙⲉⲗⲉⲧⲁⲛ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ϣⲁⲧⲟⲩⲫⲟϩ ⲉⲡⲓⲧⲓⲙⲓ ⲙⲡⲓⲁⲗⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: When the old man heard these words of the boy, he rejoiced very much, so they both got up together, and walked with each other, meditating on God's words, until they reached the boy's village.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲑⲱⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙⲁⲩⲣⲁϣⲓⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩϯ ⲛⲁϥ ⲛⲟⲩϩⲁⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥⲕⲱϯ ⲡⲉ ϫⲉⲡⲱⲥ ϥⲛⲁⲧⲏⲓϥ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲉⲩⲕⲉⲣⲓⲁ
bohairic_examples.translation: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲣⲓⲙⲓ ϩⲱⲥ ⲛⲥⲉⲣⲓⲙⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲣⲁϣⲓ ϩⲱⲥⲛⲥⲉⲣⲁϣⲓⲁⲛ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲱⲡ ϩⲱⲥ ⲛⲥⲉⲁⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲁⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: and those who weep, as though they didn't weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn't rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn't possess;

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲩⲉⲉⲛ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲃⲏϣ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟ ⲛⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲏⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲉⲩⲉⲣⲉϫⲡⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲉⲣⲉⲙⲱⲛ ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲡϭⲟⲉⲓⲥ ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And ye shall be brought forth naked in the presence of each other; and ye shall be cast forth on the mountain Romman, saith the Lord.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲩⲉϣⲱⲡⲓⲉⲩⲣⲟϫⲡⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲟⲩϣⲟⲛϯ ⲉⲥⲣⲟϫⲡ ϧⲉⲛⲧⲕⲟⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲥⲣⲟⲕϩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And the nations shall be burnt up; as a thorn in the field cast out and burnt up.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲧⲁϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲛⲓⲙⲏϣ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ϧⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲛⲁⲩⲥⲟⲣⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲛⲁⲩⲣⲟϫⲡⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛϩⲁⲛⲉⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲟⲛⲧⲟⲩ ⲙⲁⲛⲉⲥⲱⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲫⲱⲧ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲧⲙⲏϯ ⲙⲃⲁⲃⲩⲗⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲛⲧⲉϥⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲙⲡⲉⲣⲣⲉϫⲡⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲧⲉⲥⲁⲇⲓⲕⲓⲁ ϫⲉⲡⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉⲥϭⲓⲙⲡϣⲓϣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϩⲓⲧⲉⲛ ⲡϭⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲑⲟϥ ⲉⲑⲛⲁϯ ⲛⲟⲩϣⲉⲃⲓⲱ ⲛⲁⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Flee ye out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every one his soul: and be not overthrown in her iniquity; for it is the time of her retribution from the Lord; he is rendering to her a recompence.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲇⲉ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲉⲝⲁⲡⲓⲛⲁ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧϫⲁϫⲓ ⲁⲛⲛⲧⲉϥⲣⲟϫⲡϥⲓⲉ ⲛⲧⲉϥⲃⲟⲣⲃⲉⲣ ⲉϫⲱϥ ⲛⲥⲕⲉⲩⲟⲥ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϫⲟⲣϫⲥ ⲁⲛ
bohairic_examples.translation: But if he should thrust him suddenly, not through enmity, or cast any thing upon him, not from an ambuscade,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩⲛⲁⲩⲣⲟϫⲡⲡⲉ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲙⲏ ϣⲛⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϣⲱⲛⲓ ϩⲁⲛⲃⲉⲗⲗⲉⲩ ⲛⲉⲙϩⲁⲛϭⲁⲗⲉⲩ ⲛⲉⲙϩⲁⲛⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲉⲩϣⲟⲩⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲩϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲩⲕⲓⲙ ⲙⲡⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲓⲥϧⲁⲓ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉϣⲧⲉⲙⲙⲟⲩϫⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉⲩϯⲣⲁⲛ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ϫⲉⲥⲟⲛ ⲉⲟⲩⲡⲟⲣⲛⲟⲥ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥϭⲓⲛϫⲟⲛⲥ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥϣⲁⲙϣⲉⲓⲇⲱⲗⲟⲛ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥϩⲱⲟⲩϣ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥⲑⲓϧⲓ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲉϥϩⲱⲗⲉⲙ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲟⲩⲇⲉⲙⲡⲉⲣⲉⲣϣⲫⲏⲣⲛⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner. Don't even eat with such a person.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϩⲏⲇⲏ ⲁⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲓ ϩⲏⲇⲏ ⲁⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲣⲁⲙⲁⲟ ⲁⲧϭⲛⲟⲩⲛ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲉⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲟⲩⲣⲟ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϣⲫⲏⲣⲛⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛⲉⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲁϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛⲥⲱϥ ϩⲓⲫⲟⲩⲉⲓ ϣⲁⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉϯⲁⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲓⲉⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲛⲁϥⲉⲣϣⲫⲏⲣⲛϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓϩⲩⲡⲏⲣⲉⲧⲏⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲧϧⲙⲟⲙ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙⲁϣⲉ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲁϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥϫⲉϥⲛⲁⲉⲣϣⲟⲣⲡⲉⲣⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉϯⲅⲁⲗⲓⲗⲉⲁ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲙⲙⲁⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.''

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲛⲁⲩϫⲉⲁⲓⲉⲣϣⲟⲣⲡⲛϫⲉϩⲱⲃ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But you watch. 'Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁⲑⲣⲓⲧⲱⲛⲧϯⲛⲁⲉⲣϣⲟⲣⲡⲉⲣⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉϯⲅⲁⲗⲓⲗⲉⲁ .
bohairic_examples.translation: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥ ⲛϯⲥⲃⲱ ϧⲉⲛϯⲥⲩⲛⲁⲅⲱⲅⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲁⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙⲛⲁⲩⲉⲣϣⲫⲏⲣⲓⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲉⲧⲁⲫⲁⲓ ϫⲉⲙⲛⲁⲓ ⲑⲱⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲁⲓⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲏⲓⲥ ⲙⲫⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲁⲓⲕⲉϫⲟⲙ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛⲛⲉϥϫⲓϫ
bohairic_examples.translation: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, 'Where did this man get these things?' and, 'What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲛⲁⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃⲁⲩⲉⲣϣⲫⲏⲣⲓⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩϯⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲧϭⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲥϧⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϫⲉⲉⲩⲉⲛⲁⲩ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲙⲡⲟⲩⲛⲁⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲕⲁϯ .
bohairic_examples.translation: When the brethren heard these words of the holy old man, they were filled with admiration and gave glory to God, who has made his mysteries manifest to those who are worthy, for it is written, ‘They that see not shall see, and those that hear shall not understand.’
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲛⲓⲕⲁⲧⲁⲫⲣⲟⲛⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲁⲣⲓϣⲫⲏⲣⲓϧⲉⲛϩⲁⲛϣⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲕⲟ ϫⲉⲟⲩⲏⲓ ϯⲛⲁⲓⲣⲓ ⲛⲟⲩϩⲱⲃ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲛⲁϩϯ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲁⲛ ⲁⲣⲉϣⲁⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Behold, ye despisers, and look, and wonder marvelously, and vanish: for I work a work in your days, which ye will in no wise believe, though a man declare it to you.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲟϯⲅⲁⲣ ϫⲉⲛⲛⲉⲟⲩⲡⲉⲧϩⲱⲟⲩ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: We worry lest something bad might happen to him.”

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲧⲁⲡⲓⲁⲗⲟⲩ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲟϯ
bohairic_examples.translation: When the young man heard this, he was frightened.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 2 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:20-41)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩⲁⲩⲉⲣϩⲟϯⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϩⲱⲥⲧⲉ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲕⲱϯ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲟⲩⲉⲣⲏⲟⲩ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲥⲃⲱ ⲙⲃⲉⲣⲓ ⲡⲉ ϫⲉϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲉⲣϣⲓϣⲓ ϥⲟⲩⲁϩⲥⲁϩⲛⲓ ⲛⲛⲓⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛⲁⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲧⲟⲛ ⲥⲉⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲛⲁϥ
bohairic_examples.translation: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, 'What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϣⲁⲛ ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲙⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲃⲁⲣⲛⲁⲃⲁⲥ ⲉⲧⲉⲙⲙⲟⲛⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲣϣⲓϣⲓ ⲙⲙⲁⲩⲉϣⲧⲉⲙⲉⲣϩⲱⲃ.
bohairic_examples.translation: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛϫⲓⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲁⲓⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲟⲩⲉⲧ ⲡϩⲱⲃ ⲙⲫⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲉⲧ ⲡϩⲱⲃ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲭⲉⲧ ⲟⲩⲛⲁϩϯ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧⲉⲧⲉⲣϩⲱⲃⲛϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Many are the lives of these holy and pious brothers, each of whom engaged in a different work: yet all shared one faith and one Spirit, working in all their endeavors.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲇⲉ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲭⲁⲥ ⲁϧⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛϯϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲁⲥ ⲟⲩϩⲱⲃ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲛⲁⲛⲉϥⲉⲧⲁⲥⲉⲣϩⲱⲃⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲛϧⲏⲧ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But Jesus said, 'Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲡⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϩⲉⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ ⲛⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲁϥϭⲟϫⲓ ⲛⲥⲁⲡⲓⲑⲉⲃⲓⲟ ⲁϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲓϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯⲛⲥⲛⲁⲃⲟⲧ ⲉϥⲙⲁϩⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲓⲉϫⲱⲣϩ ⲉϥⲉⲣⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲓⲍⲉⲓⲛ ⲛⲛⲓⲙⲁ ⲛϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲉϫⲱⲣϩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He spoke this in peace, because on every occasion he followed humility: he remained six months in this suffering, drawing water for the brethren during the night and washing their seats during the night.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲁⲣⲉⲛⲓⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲑⲱⲟⲩϯ ϩⲁⲣⲟϥ ⲙⲡⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲧⲕⲩⲣⲓⲁⲕⲏ ⲉⲩϩⲓⲟⲓ ⲛⲛⲟⲩⲙⲉⲩⲓ ϧⲁⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲉϫⲱⲣϩ ⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲉⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉⲛⲉϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲛⲟⲙϯ ϣⲁⲧⲉⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ϣⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ϣⲁⲩϣⲉ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲉⲩϯⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ϫⲉⲟⲩⲏⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲁⲥϩⲟⲗϫ ⲛϫⲉⲧⲉϥⲥⲃⲱ ⲉⲙⲁϣⲱ ⲡⲉ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲓ ϣⲁⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲉϣⲁϥϯϩⲟ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲛⲁⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲉϥϣⲏⲕ ⲓⲉ ⲉϥϧⲟⲥⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲙⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲭⲁⲣⲱϥ ϣⲁⲧⲉⲛⲓⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲣⲁⲛⲁⲭⲱⲣⲓⲛ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲉϥϣⲓⲛⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲕ ⲥⲁⲡⲥⲁ ⲟⲩⲧⲱϥ ⲛⲉⲙⲏⲓ ⲙⲡⲉⲛⲑⲣⲉϥϫⲟⲥ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲙⲏⲡⲟⲧⲉ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲕⲟⲩϫⲓ ⲧⲁⲕⲟ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲙⲕⲁϩ ⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲟⲙⲕϥ ⲉⲩⲥⲟⲡ . ⲛⲁϥⲟⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲟⲛ ⲙⲙⲁⲓϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ϩⲱⲥ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲧⲉϥϣⲧⲉⲙⲧⲉϥⲣⲓ ⲥⲉⲛⲉ ⲓⲉ ⲋ ⲛϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲙⲙⲏⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛϯⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙⲧⲉϥⲥⲃⲱ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉϥⲕⲁϯ ⲛⲉⲙⲧⲉϥⲁⲥⲕⲩⲥⲓⲥ ⲉⲡⲓⲇⲏ ⲛⲁⲣⲉⲛⲓⲭⲣⲓⲁ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲡⲉ ϫⲉⲟⲩⲏⲓ ⲛⲁⲣⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲁϥ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲉϣⲁⲕϫⲉⲙϩⲟⲩⲟⲥⲛⲭⲣⲓⲁ ⲛⲧⲁϥ ⲡⲉ ⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲟⲓⲕⲟⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϣⲉⲙϣⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲏⲓ ⲛⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ . ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲥⲟⲡ ⲁ ⲁⲡⲁ ⲑⲉⲟⲫⲓⲗⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲏⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲉⲧⲁϩⲟϥ ⲛⲧⲉϥⲁⲓϥ ⲛⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲙⲟⲩⲓ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲑⲱⲧ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲁϥⲫⲱⲧ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲉϣⲧⲉⲙⲉⲣⲡⲁⲓϩⲱⲃ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The brothers would gather with him on the Sabbath and on Sunday. Throughout the entire night, they would share their thoughts with him, listening to his strong words until dawn. When they left him, they gave glory to God, for his teaching was very sweet to them. If they came to him and he noticed any deep or grave thought troubling them, he would beseech them, saying: ‘My brothers, if any one of you is troubled by a deep or serious thought, let him remain silent until the other brothers have gone, and then let him ask me privately, in secret, between the two of us. Let him not speak before his brothers, lest perhaps he lose the little one through his own thoughts and be overcome at the same time by pain of heart.’ He so loved strangers that in his cell he would admit five or six strangers daily who came from distant regions to hear his wisdom, understanding, and ascetic practices. For he possessed spiritual gifts and to him everyone would send offerings such that he had more than two hundred charismata. All of these were managed by the steward, who at all times served in his house. Often Apa Theophilus sought to apprehend him and make him bishop of Thmouis, but he fled so that this would not happen.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲧⲟⲧϥ ϯⲙⲁϯ ⲉⲟⲩⲫⲁϣⲛⲓ ⲉⲥⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲛϩⲟⲩⲟ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲟⲛ ⲉⲧⲉϥⲟⲓ ⲙⲙⲉⲥⲓⲧⲏ ⲥⲛⲧⲉ ⲟⲩⲇⲓⲁⲑⲏⲕⲏ ⲉⲥⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲑⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥⲛⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲉϫⲉⲛϩⲁⲛⲱϣ ⲉⲩⲥⲱⲧⲡ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉϣⲱⲡⲁⲓϣⲁⲛⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥⲙⲫⲓⲣⲓ ⲉⲡⲓϫⲓⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ϯⲛⲁⲭⲁⲟⲩⲧⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲁⲓϩⲱⲗ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲧⲁϣⲧⲉⲙⲧⲁⲙⲟⲕ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲛⲓϯⲙⲓ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲡϣⲁϥⲉ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲛⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲕⲟⲩϫⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: When I begin to tell you the lives of our Fathers, I will omit no place into which I have entered to instruct you—neither those who dwell in cities, nor in villages, nor in the desert, nor those who live only briefly among others.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲡⲁⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥⲛⲕⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲡⲉϥϣϫⲉⲙϫⲟⲙ ⲛϫⲟⲕϥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ .
bohairic_examples.translation: saying, 'This man began to build, and wasn't able to finish.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲩϫⲟⲥⲟⲛ ⲉⲑⲃⲏⲧϥ ϫⲉⲓⲥϫⲉⲛⲛⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲁⲩϫⲫⲟϥ . ϣⲁⲧⲉϥϣⲉ ⲛⲁϥ ϩⲁⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲙⲡⲉϩⲗⲓ ⲛⲥⲩⲛⲟⲩⲥⲓⲁ ⲛϩⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛϧⲏⲧϥ
bohairic_examples.translation: It is said of him that from the day he was born until the day he went to God, no male sperm came out of him.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲧⲁⲓⲙⲁⲓⲏ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲙⲡϣⲧⲱⲣⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲇⲓⲁⲑⲏⲕⲏ ⲉⲥⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲑⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥⲛⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲉϫⲉⲛϩⲁⲛⲱϣ ⲉⲩⲥⲱⲧⲡ .
bohairic_examples.translation: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲓⲣⲁⲛ ⲛⲛⲓⲫⲩⲗⲏ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲥⲁ ⲙⲡⲉⲙϩⲓⲧ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲙⲱⲓⲧ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲛⲁⲑⲁⲗⲱⲛ ϣⲁⲉϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲉⲁⲙⲙⲁⲑ ϯⲁⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲧⲉⲁⲩⲛⲱⲛ ⲡⲓϭⲓⲏ ⲛⲇⲁⲙⲁⲥⲕⲟⲥ ⲉⲡⲉⲙϩⲓⲧ ⲥⲁⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲧ ⲉⲑⲣⲟⲩϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲡⲥⲁⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲙⲁⲛϣⲁⲓ ⲙⲫⲓⲟⲙ ⲑⲏⲉⲑⲛⲁϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲟⲩⲕⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲛⲇⲁⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And these are the names of the tribes from the northern corner, on the side of the descent that draws a line to the entrance of Emath the palace of Aelam, the border of Damascus northward on the side of Emath the palace; and they shall have the eastern parts as far as the sea, for Dan, one portion.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲕⲉⲇⲙⲡⲁⲓⲥⲁⲛⲧⲉⲡⲥⲫⲓⲣ ⲧⲣⲁⲡⲉⲍⲁ ⲃϯ ⲉⲩⲭⲏ ⲉϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲉⲩϧⲟⲗϧⲉⲗ ϩⲓϫⲱⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Four on one side and four on the other side behind the gate; upon them they kill the victims, in front of the eight tables of sacrifices.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲥⲁ ⲙⲫⲣⲏⲥ ϥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲓⲥϫⲉⲛ ⲑⲁⲙⲁⲛ ϣⲁⲡⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲁⲛⲧⲓⲗⲟⲅⲓⲁ ⲛⲕⲁⲇⲏⲥ ⲡⲓⲭⲓⲙⲁⲣⲣⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϭⲓ ⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲉⲡⲓⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙⲫⲓⲟⲙ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲓϭⲓⲏⲛⲧⲉⲡⲥⲁⲙⲫⲣⲏⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And the southern and south-western coasts are from Thaeman and the city of palm-trees, to the water of Marimoth Cadem, reaching forth to the great sea. This part is the south and south-west.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϩⲏⲇⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲣⲟⲩϩⲓ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲡⲉⲓⲇⲏ ⲛⲉϯⲡⲁⲣⲁⲥⲕⲉⲩⲏ ⲧⲉ ⲉⲧϧⲁϫⲱϥⲙⲡⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ
bohairic_examples.translation: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϩⲱⲥⲧⲉ ⲡϭⲟⲓⲥⲙⲡⲓⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛⲡⲉ ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙⲫⲣⲱⲙⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲩϯ ⲛϩⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ⲡⲉ ϫⲉ ⲁⲛ ϥⲛⲁⲉⲣⲫⲁϧⲣⲓ ⲉⲣⲟϥϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲉⲣⲕⲁⲧⲏⲅⲟⲣⲓⲛ ⲉⲣⲟϥ
bohairic_examples.translation: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲡⲓϩⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲧⲉⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲧⲧⲟⲓ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲃⲉⲛⲁⲣⲭⲏⲇⲉⲕⲧⲱⲛ ⲁⲓⲭⲱ ⲛⲟⲩⲥⲉⲛϯ ⲉϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲕⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲡⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁϩⲉⲙ ⲕⲱⲧ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥⲥⲟⲙⲥ ϫⲉⲁϥⲕⲱⲧ ⲛⲁϣ ⲛⲣⲏϯ .
bohairic_examples.translation: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛⲑⲱϩⲉⲙ ⲛⲁⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲙⲙⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣⲛⲥⲁⲃⲉⲕⲁⲧⲁⲥⲁⲣⲝ ⲙⲙⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛϫⲱⲣⲓ ⲙⲙⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛⲉⲩⲅⲉⲛⲏⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲓϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯⲛϩⲁⲛⲥⲁⲃⲉⲩⲙⲁϩⲁⲡ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲡⲉϯϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲓϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲉⲩϫⲫⲓⲟ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲙⲙⲟⲛ ϩⲗⲓⲛⲥⲁⲃⲉϧⲉⲛⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛϣϫⲟⲙ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲉⲉⲣⲇⲓⲁⲕⲣⲓⲛⲓⲛ ⲟⲩⲧⲉⲡⲉϥⲥⲟⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: I say this to move you to shame. Isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲁⲛⲥⲟϫ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲡⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛϩⲁⲛⲥⲁⲃⲉⲩϧⲉⲛⲡⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲁⲛϫⲱⲃ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛϫⲱⲣⲓ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲧⲁⲓⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲇⲉ ⲧⲉⲛϣⲏϣ
bohairic_examples.translation: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲉⲇⲉ ⲛⲥⲟϫ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲟⲩⲛⲉⲙⲉⲛⲥⲁⲃⲏ.
bohairic_examples.translation: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲁⲓϣⲟⲡⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲥⲭⲏⲙⲁ ⲉⲣⲟⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲡⲟⲗⲗⲱ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲥⲃⲱ ⲉϣⲧⲉⲙⲉⲣⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗⲛⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲥϧⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ϫⲉⲛⲛⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲡⲉϥϣⲫⲏⲣ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲫⲱⲧⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗⲛϯⲡⲟⲣⲛⲓⲁ ⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲉⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲁⲁⲓϥ ϥⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲫⲏ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲡⲟⲣⲛⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉⲡⲉϥⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲙⲙⲓⲛⲙⲙⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Flee sexual immorality! 'Every sin that a man does is outside the body,' but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲧⲉϥⲙⲁⲩ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϥⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲟϩⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ϩⲁⲣⲟϥ ⲉⲩⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲣⲟϥ
bohairic_examples.translation: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲇⲉ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲉⲕⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲟⲩⲱⲙ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉⲕⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲓⲧⲉ ⲉⲕⲁⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲛⲧⲟⲧⲕⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗⲙⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲁⲙⲟⲛⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉⲕⲉⲣϣⲓϣⲓ ⲭⲱⲣⲓⲥⲁⲛⲁϣ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲛⲉⲕⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉⲛⲉϩ
bohairic_examples.translation: Therefore, if you eat, eat according to your will; if you refrain from eating, refrain according to your ability without making an oath, and may you never sin.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲙⲙⲟⲛ ϩⲗⲓⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗⲙⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲉϥⲛⲁ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉⲣⲱϥ ⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ϣϫⲟⲙ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲉⲥⲟϥϥ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲣⲱϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲣⲟⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉϯϩⲁⲡ ⲉⲛⲏⲉⲧⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙⲁϩⲁⲡ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: For what have I to do with also judging those who are outside? Don't you judge those who are within?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲧⲉⲃⲛⲏ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉϥϭⲟⲡ ⲫⲟⲣϫ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲱⲗⲓ ⲛⲛⲓⲓⲉⲃ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉϥϭⲟⲡ ⲉⲧⲫⲟⲣϫ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲓⲛⲓⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲣⲱϥ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁⲟⲩⲟⲙⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: Every beast parting the hoof and making divisions of two claws, and chewing the cud among beasts, these ye shall eat.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲭⲩⲣⲟⲅⲗⲩⲗⲗⲓⲟⲛ ϫⲉϥⲓⲛⲓⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲫⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓϭⲟⲡ ⲛⲧⲉⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲫⲟⲣϫ ⲁⲛ ⲫⲁⲓ ϥϭⲁϧⲉⲙ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ
bohairic_examples.translation: And the rabbit, because it chews the cud, but does not divide the hoof, this is unclean to you.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲣⲁⲧⲫⲁⲧ ϫⲉⲫⲁⲓ ϥⲓⲛⲓⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓϭⲟⲡ ⲛⲧⲉⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲫⲟⲣϫ ⲁⲛ ⲫⲁⲓ ϥϭⲁϧⲉⲙ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ
bohairic_examples.translation: And the hare, because it does not chew the cud, and does not divide the hoof, this is unclean to you.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲁⲙⲟⲛⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ϧⲁⲧⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲃⲟⲧ ⲛⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ϣⲁⲧⲟⲩⲥⲓⲙⲡⲉϥⲥⲁⲓϫⲉⲛⲉⲟⲩⲥⲁⲓⲉ ⲡⲉ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲓⲛⲓ ⲥⲭⲉⲇⲟⲛ ⲉϫⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲟⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And they kept him with them for a month, until they were sated of his beauty; for he was beautiful in form, so handsome that one could almost say that he was an angel of God.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲧⲙⲉⲧⲥⲁⲓⲉⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉϥⲥⲁⲓⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲥⲓⲱⲛ: ⲉϥⲉⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲭⲁⲣⲱϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Out of Sion comes the excellence of his beauty.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲣⲉⲛⲁⲓ ϣⲟⲡ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲁϥⲙⲧⲟⲛ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲡⲧⲉϯⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥⲥⲁⲓⲁⲩⲧⲁϩⲟ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲓⲱⲧ ⲙⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁⲧⲓⲕⲟⲛ ⲁⲩⲁⲓϥ ⲛⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲉϯⲡⲟⲗⲓⲥ ⲥⲁⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: In the meantime, the bishop of Sais passed away, and they took his spiritual father, and made him bishop of Sais.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 2 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:20-41)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲥⲟⲩⲥⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲣⲓⲕⲓ ⲙⲃⲁⲗ ϧⲉⲛϯϧⲁⲉⲛⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥⲉⲥⲉⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛϫⲉϯⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲝ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓⲣⲉϥⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲉⲩⲉⲧⲱⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ϩⲱⲛ ⲥⲉⲛⲁϣⲟⲃⲧⲉⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲛ ⲉⲣⲉϣⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥⲙⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲉϣⲧⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲛⲟⲩϣⲡ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲣⲉϣ ⲟⲩⲕⲁⲕⲓⲁ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲙⲡⲉ ⲡϭⲟⲉⲓⲥ ⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Shall the trumpet sound in the city, and the people not be alarmed? shall there be evil in a city which the Lord has not wrought?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲁϥϣⲁⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲥⲏϥⲓ ⲉⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲁϥϣⲧⲉⲙⲉⲣⲥⲓⲙⲙⲉⲛⲓⲛⲛϯⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲅⲟⲥⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲁϥϣⲧⲉⲙⲟⲣϥϥ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲉⲣⲉϯⲥⲏϥⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲥⲉⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲛⲛⲟⲩⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲑⲁⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲧⲉⲥⲁⲛⲟⲙⲓⲁ ⲁⲩϥⲟⲧⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϥⲥⲛⲟϥ ϯⲛⲁⲕⲱϯ ⲛⲥⲱϥ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But if the watchman see the sword coming, and do not sound the trumpet, and the people do not watch; and the sword come, and take a soul from among them, that soul is taken because of its iniquity; but the blood thereof will I require at the watchman's hand.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲩⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲕⲁⲗⲱⲥ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲁⲛϫⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲛⲑⲟⲕⲟⲩⲥⲁⲙⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲇⲁⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Then the Jews answered him, 'Don't we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲉϫⲉ ϯⲥϩⲓⲙⲓ ⲛⲁϥ ⲛⲥⲁⲙⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ ϫⲉⲡⲱⲥ ⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲟⲩⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁⲓ ⲕⲉⲣⲉⲧⲓⲛ ⲛⲧⲟⲧⲉⲥⲱ ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲟⲩⲥϩⲓⲙⲓⲛⲥⲁⲙⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥⲟⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲡⲁⲣⲉ ⲛⲓⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁⲓ ⲙⲟⲩϫⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲥⲁⲙⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, 'How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?' (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϩⲓⲧϥ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲡⲉϥϩⲟ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛⲛⲉϥϭⲁⲗⲁⲩϫ ⲉϥϣⲉⲡϩⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲁⲓⲛⲉⲟⲩⲥⲁⲙⲁⲣⲓⲧⲏⲥⲡⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He fell on his face at Jesus' feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲁⲩⲟⲩⲱⲧⲉⲃ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲧⲁⲓ ⲁⲓⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲙⲁⲣⲟⲛ ⲉⲇⲱⲧⲁⲓⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲛϫⲉⲓⲱⲥⲏⲫⲥⲁⲙⲉⲛϩⲏⲛⲛⲉϥⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϫⲉⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲇⲱⲑⲁⲓⲙ
bohairic_examples.translation: And the man said to him, They have departed hence, for I heard them saying, Let us go to Dothaim; and Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothaim.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϩⲓⲫⲁϩⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲫⲓⲣ ⲙⲙⲁϩⲃ ⲥⲁⲙⲛⲁⲓⲛⲉⲙⲥⲁⲙⲛⲁⲓⲕⲁⲧⲁϯⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲁⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲓⲁⲩⲗⲏ ⲉⲩⲓⲣⲓ ⲙⲓⲉ ⲙⲙⲁϩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲅ ⲛⲥⲧⲩⲗⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙⲅ ⲙⲃⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲛⲧⲱⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: and their pillars three, and their sockets three.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϩⲁⲛϣⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉⲩϫⲟⲗϩ ⲥⲁⲙⲛⲁⲓⲛⲉⲙⲥⲁⲙⲛⲁⲓⲛⲓⲗⲁⲕϩ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲉⲗⲁⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓⲥⲫⲓⲣ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϥⲟⲩⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϥϣⲓⲕ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϥⲥⲁ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And there were secret windows; and he measured from side to side, to the roofing of the porch; and the sides of the house were closely planked.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϧⲉⲛⲡϫⲓⲛⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϩⲏⲡⲡⲉ ⲛⲁϥϣⲟⲡ ϧⲁⲧⲉⲛⲛⲉⲛⲥⲫⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟⲧ ϧⲉⲛⲡϫⲓⲛⲑⲣⲉⲛⲧⲁⲥⲑⲟⲛ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩϣϣⲏⲛ ⲉϥⲟϣ ⲥⲁⲙⲛⲁⲓⲛⲉⲙⲥⲁⲙⲛⲁⲓⲙⲙⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: as I returned; and, behold, on the brink of the river there were very many trees on this side and on that side.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲛⲉⲛⲉⲣⲕⲗⲏⲣⲟⲛⲟⲙⲓⲛ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ϩⲓⲙⲏⲣ ⲙⲡⲓⲓⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥⲛⲉⲙⲥⲁⲙⲛⲏϫⲉⲁⲛⲟⲩⲱ ⲉⲛϭⲓ ⲛⲛⲉⲛⲕⲗⲏⲣⲟⲥ ϩⲓⲙⲏⲣ ⲙⲡⲓⲓⲟⲣⲇⲁⲛⲏⲥ ⲥⲁⲡⲉⲓⲉⲃⲧ
bohairic_examples.translation: And we will not any longer inherit with them from the other side of Jordan and onwards, because we have our full inheritance on the side beyond Jordan eastward.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϫⲉⲉⲩⲉⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲙⲱⲓⲧ ⲁⲛⲟⲛ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲛⲉⲙⲟϣⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲫⲣⲁⲛ ⲙⲡϭⲟⲉⲓⲥ ⲡⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩϯ ϣⲁⲡⲉⲛⲉϩⲛⲉⲙⲥⲁⲙⲛⲏ.
bohairic_examples.translation: For all other nations shall walk everyone in his own way, but we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲓⲉⲟⲩⲉⲧⲉⲃ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗⲥⲁⲙⲛⲏⲛⲇⲁⲙⲁⲥⲕⲟⲥ ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲡϭⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And I will carry you away beyond Damascus, saith the Lord, the Almighty God is his name.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϩⲟϫϩⲉϫ ⲁⲕⲧⲱⲃϩ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲓⲛⲁϩⲙⲉⲕ ⲁⲓⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉⲣⲟⲕ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉⲧϩⲏⲡⲛⲧⲉⲟⲩⲥⲁⲣⲁⲑⲏⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: Thou didst call upon me in trouble, and I delivered thee; I heard thee in the secret place of the storm: I proved thee at the water of Strife. Pause.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲭⲁⲩ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲟⲩⲧⲣⲟⲭⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲟⲩⲣⲱⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲉⲛ ⲡϩⲟ ⲛⲟⲩⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲟⲩⲭⲣⲱⲙ ⲉϣⲁϥⲣⲱⲕϩ ⲛⲟⲩⲓⲁϩϣϣⲏⲛ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲟⲩϣⲁϩ ⲉϣⲁϥⲧϩⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲛϩⲁⲛⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲕⲉϭⲟϫⲓ ⲛⲥⲱⲟⲩ ⲛϧⲣⲏⲓϧⲉⲛⲧⲉⲕⲥⲁⲣⲁⲑⲏⲟⲩⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛϧⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉⲕϫⲱⲛⲧ ⲉⲕⲉϣⲧⲉⲣⲑⲱⲣⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲕⲉⲙⲟϩ ⲛⲛⲟⲩϩⲟ ⲛϣⲱϣ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲩⲉⲕⲱϯ ⲛⲥⲁⲡⲉⲕⲣⲁⲛ ⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ
bohairic_examples.translation: Make their princes as Oreb and Zeb, and Zebee and Salmana; even all their princes:

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲙⲏⲡⲱⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲥⲱⲗⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛⲇⲓⲁⲑⲏⲕⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲫⲙⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ ⲉⲧⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲙⲉⲛϯ ⲛⲛⲉⲥⲟϩⲓⲟⲩⲥⲁⲣⲁⲑⲏⲟⲩⲉⲩⲉⲓⲛⲓ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲁⲥϣⲁⲛⲓ ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲥ ⲉⲩϩⲱⲙⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: except it also take away your covenant of death, and your trust in Hades shall by no means stand: if the rushing storm should come upon you, ye shall be beaten down by it.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩϩⲁⲛⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙⲛⲁⲩⲟϩⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩⲙⲡⲉϥⲕⲱϯ ⲉⲣⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲋ ⲛⲧⲉⲛϩ ⲉⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲕⲉⲋ ⲛⲧⲉⲛϩ ⲉⲡⲓⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϧⲉⲛⲃ ⲙⲉⲛ ⲛⲁⲩϩⲱⲃⲥ ⲙⲡⲟⲩϩⲟ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϧⲉⲛⲃ ⲛⲁⲩϩⲱⲃⲥ ⲛⲛⲓϭⲁⲗⲁⲩϫ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲩϩⲏⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲕⲉⲃ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And seraphs stood round about him: each one had six wings: and with two they covered their face, and with two they covered their feet, and with two they flew.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲁⲫⲓⲙⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲉⲣⲉ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩϫⲉⲃⲥ ϧⲉⲛⲧⲉϥϫⲓϫ ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁϥϭⲓⲧⲥ ϧⲉⲛϯⲉϭⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲉⲣϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And there was sent to me one of the seraphs, and he had in his hand a coal, which he had taken off the altar with the tongs:

senses: fleshly one (substantive; being of a fleshly, material substance, as specifically opposed to a "spiritual" or "psychic" one)
fleshly, of the flesh (negative; as opposed to spiritual) (attributive; being of a fleshly, material substance, as specifically opposed to a "spiritual" or "psychic" one)
human flesh ([part of] the human body; or simply, a human being)
human flesh (attributive; [part of] the human body; or simply, a human being)
human flesh (inverted attributive, nominal referent; referent: [part of] the human body; or simply, a human being)
living being; animal (as opposed to living plants)
flesh (part of the human being; in opposition to πνεῦμα and/or ψυχή)
human flesh (inverted attributive, attributive referent; referent: [part of] the human body; or simply, a human being)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϩⲟⲡⲱⲥⲛⲧⲉϣⲧⲉⲙⲥⲁⲣⲝⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟ ⲙⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ .
bohairic_examples.translation: that no flesh should boast before God.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲕⲁⲛ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲁⲕϣⲁⲛϭⲓ ⲙⲡⲉⲕⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲁⲥϣⲁⲛϭⲓ ⲛϫⲉϯⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲁⲥⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲉⲩⲉϭⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲟⲩϩⲟϫϩⲉϫⲛⲧⲟⲩⲥⲁⲣⲝⲛϫⲉⲛⲁⲓ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲇⲉ ϯϯⲁⲥⲟ ⲉⲣⲱⲧⲉⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲛⲉ ⲙⲡⲉⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲉⲙⲙⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲕⲟⲩϫⲓ ⲛⲁⲩⲛⲁⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲁⲛ ⲡⲉⲛϫⲉⲥⲁⲣⲝⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲛⲓⲥⲱⲧⲡ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲥⲟⲧⲡⲟⲩ ⲁϥϫⲉϫⲉⲃ ⲛⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϩⲓⲥⲕⲉⲛⲡⲓⲙⲱⲓⲧ ⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲓϯ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲥⲁⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲇⲉ ϣⲁϥⲓⲛϫⲉⲡⲥⲁⲧⲁⲛⲁⲥⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲉϥⲱⲗⲓ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲁⲧϥ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛϩⲁⲛⲡⲁⲣⲁⲃⲟⲗⲏ ϫⲉⲡⲱⲥ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ϣϫⲟⲙⲛⲧⲉⲡⲥⲁⲧⲁⲛⲁⲥϩⲓⲡⲥⲁⲧⲁⲛⲁⲥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ
bohairic_examples.translation: He summoned them, and said to them in parables, 'How can Satan cast out Satan?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥⲭⲏ ⲡⲉ ϩⲓⲡϣⲁϥⲉ ⲛⲙ ⲛⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϫⲱⲣϩ ⲉϥⲉⲣⲡⲓⲣⲁⲍⲓⲛ ⲙⲙⲟϥⲛϫⲉⲡⲥⲁⲧⲁⲛⲁⲥⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥⲭⲏ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲑⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲛⲁⲩϣⲉⲙϣⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲟⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲫⲟⲣϫ ⲉⲛⲉⲛϭⲟⲡ ⲛⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲟⲩⲓⲉⲃ ⲡⲓϫⲁⲙⲟⲩⲗ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲓⲣⲁⲫⲁⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲓⲭⲩⲣⲟⲅⲗⲓⲗⲗⲓⲟⲛϫⲉⲥⲉⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓⲛϫⲉⲛⲁⲓ ⲥⲉⲫⲱⲣϫ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲛ ⲛⲛⲉⲛϭⲟⲡ ⲛⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲁⲓ ϩⲁⲛⲁⲕⲁⲑⲁⲣⲧⲟⲛ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲛⲉ
bohairic_examples.translation: And these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, and of those that divide the hoofs, and make distinct claws; the camel, and the hare, and the rabbit; because they chew the cud, and do not divide the hoof, these are unclean to you.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲧⲉⲃⲛⲱⲟⲩⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲫⲏ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲉⲛⲓϭⲟⲡ ⲛⲧⲉⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲫⲟⲣϫ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲱⲗⲓ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲓⲉⲃ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓⲉϥⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲩⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲩϭⲁϧⲉⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲛⲁϭⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲙⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲛⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲩϭⲁϧⲉⲙ
bohairic_examples.translation: And whichever among the beasts divides the hoof and makes claws, and does not chew the cud, shall be unclean to you; every one that touches their dead bodies shall be unclean till evening.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ϧⲁⲧⲟⲧⲉⲛ ⲛϫⲉⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲓⲥⲓⲇⲱⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲓⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲉϣⲓⲏⲧ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲛⲓⲁⲣⲉⲧⲏ ⲛⲧⲉⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲡⲁⲙⲱ ⲁⲓϯϩⲟ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥϭⲓⲙⲱⲓⲧ ϧⲁϫⲱⲓ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉⲡϣⲁϥⲉ ⲉⲫⲙⲁ ⲛⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲡⲁⲙⲱ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲛϭⲓϣⲫⲏⲣⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲉϧⲉⲛϯⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉϥϫⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲛⲁⲩⲟϩⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩ ⲥⲁⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲛϫⲉⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓ ⲡⲓⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲩⲧⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲁⲙⲙⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲑⲉⲟⲇⲱⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲕⲉⲙⲏϣ ⲛⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲥⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲡⲉⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⲁϫⲉⲟⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲉⲣⲟϥ . ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲓϧⲉⲗⲗⲟ ϫⲉⲓⲥϫⲉⲛⲡⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲓ ⲉⲡⲁⲓϣⲁϥⲉ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲓⲕⲱⲧ ⲛⲧⲁⲓⲣⲓ ⲁⲓϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲥ ⲛϯⲓⲣⲓ ⲙⲫⲙⲉⲩⲓ ⲁⲛ ϫⲉⲁⲓⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲙⲡⲁϩⲏⲧ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲁⲓϫⲟϥ ⲛϥⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲉϫⲟϥ ⲁⲛ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲃⲏⲗⲛⲧⲁⲥⲁⲑⲙⲓⲉϫⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛϣⲟⲣⲡ ⲛⲧⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ϫⲉⲁⲛ ⲫⲁⲫⲙⲟⲩ ⲡⲉ ϣⲁⲛ ⲫⲁⲫⲱⲛϧ ⲡⲉ ⲙⲡⲁⲓϫⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ϯⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲓⲕ ⲛϫⲓⲛϫⲏ ⲉⲃⲏⲗ ⲉⲡϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲁϫⲓϫ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲡⲓⲭⲁⲥ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲁϩⲏⲧ ϫⲉⲁⲓⲉⲣⲟⲩⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ⲟⲛ ϯⲛⲁϣⲉ ⲛⲏⲓ ϯϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲁⲛ ϫⲉⲁⲓⲉⲣⲟⲩⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲓⲟⲓ ⲛϣⲁⲙϣⲉⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ϯϫⲉⲙⲁⲣⲓⲕⲓ ⲉⲣⲟⲓ ϫⲉϯⲓⲣⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲙⲫⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲙⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Abba Isidore of Shiet, the presbyter, recounted to us the virtues of Abba Pambo: “I entreated him to show me the way to the desert place where Abba Pamo dwelled so that I might see him. And these are the men who, marveling at him, stood with him when he departed from the body, namely Abba Macarius the presbyter, Abba Ammon, Abba Theodorus, and many others chosen among the brothers.” and they said to him: “Father, give us a word so that we may live by it.” And the old man spoke to them thus: “From the time I entered this desert and built myself a cell and stayed there, I do not remember a single word I have spoken without repentance, for I have never spoken a word unless I first weighed whether it was for death or for life. Nor am I aware that I ever ate bread for free, unless it came from the labor of my own hands. I never brought it into my heart that I had lived a monastic life, but now as I am about to depart from the world, I do not say to you that I have lived a pious life according to God; rather, I bring an accusation against myself, that I have not achieved the will of God.”

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛϣⲧⲉⲙⲉⲣⲥⲕⲁⲛⲇⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉⲥⲑⲉ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲁϣⲉ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲉⲫⲓⲟⲙ ϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲕⲱⲓⲙⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲧⲉⲃⲧ ⲛϩⲟⲩⲓⲧ ⲉⲑⲛⲁⲓ ⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲁⲗⲓⲧϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲕϣⲁⲛⲟⲩⲱⲛ ⲛⲣⲱϥ ⲉⲕⲉϫⲓⲙⲓⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲑⲉⲣⲓⲁⲗⲓⲧⲥ ⲙⲏⲓⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉϫⲱⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲑⲟϥ ⲇⲉ ⲉϥⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧϣⲟⲃⲓ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩ ⲧⲉⲧⲉⲛϭⲱⲛⲧ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲁⲛⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲏⲓⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲑⲉⲣⲓϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Shall we give, or shall we not give?' But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, 'Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲑⲟϥ ⲇⲉ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲟⲩⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁϣⲉ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲛⲧⲉⲛϣⲉⲡ ⲱⲛⲥⲁⲑⲉⲣⲓⲛⲱⲓⲕ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲉⲛϯ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲟⲩⲱⲙ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But he answered them, 'You give them something to eat.' They asked him, 'Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ϣϫⲟⲙ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉϯ ⲙⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲥⲁⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲛⲧⲛⲥⲁⲑⲉⲣⲓⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲧⲏⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲛⲓϩⲏⲕⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲩⲙⲃⲟⲛ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor.' They grumbled against her.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲓⲉ ⲁⲟⲩⲏⲣ ⲙⲁⲗⲗⲟⲛ ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲫⲁⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲑⲃⲁⲛⲥⲁⲑⲉⲣⲓⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲁⲛⲁⲅⲕⲉⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲏⲓ ϩⲱ ⲡⲉ ⲉⲑⲣⲓϫⲉⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲛⲓⲟϯ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ
bohairic_examples.translation: How much more must I, who am a debtor of ten thousand talents, find it necessary to narrate what I have seen regarding our holy Fathers?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁϥⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲉⲣⲅⲁⲧⲏⲥ ⲉϯ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲑⲉⲣⲓⲉⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲟⲩⲟⲣⲡⲟⲩ ⲉⲡⲉϥⲓⲁϩⲁⲗⲟⲗⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉϭⲓ ⲛϯϣⲟⲩⲣⲏ ⲉⲥⲙⲉϩ ⲛϫⲉⲃⲥ ⲛⲭⲣⲱⲙ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲙⲁⲛⲉⲣϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟ ⲙⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲙⲟϩ ⲛⲧⲉϥϫⲓϫ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲑⲩⲛⲟⲩϥⲓⲉⲧⲥⲁⲧⲏⲟⲩⲧⲉⲧϣⲟⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲟⲗϥ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙⲡⲓⲕⲁⲧⲁⲡⲉⲧⲁⲥⲙⲁ
bohairic_examples.translation: And he shall take his censer full of coals of fire off the altar, which is before the Lord; and he shall fill his hands with fine compound incense, and shall bring it within the veil.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲥⲥϧⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲅⲁⲣ ϧⲉⲛⲫⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲙⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ϫⲉⲛⲛⲉⲕϯⲥⲁⲭⲟⲗⲉϩⲣⲉⲛⲉϩⲉ ⲉϥϩⲓ ⲙⲏ ⲁⲥⲉⲣⲙⲉⲗⲓⲛ ⲙⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ϧⲁⲛⲓⲉϩⲱⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: For it is written in the law of Moses, 'You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.' Is it for the oxen that God cares,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲥϫⲱ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲛϫⲉϯⲅⲣⲁⲫⲏϫⲉⲛⲛⲉⲕϯⲥⲁⲭⲟⲗⲉϩⲣⲉⲛⲉϩⲉ ⲉϥϩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲅⲁⲧⲏ ⲥϥⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲃⲉⲭⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: For the Scripture says, 'You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲛⲉⲕϯⲥⲁⲭⲟⲗⲉϩⲣⲉⲛⲉϩⲉ ⲉϥϩⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treads out the corn.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲱⲣⲕ ⲛⲁϥ ⲙⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲉϫⲛⲡⲓⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲟⲛ ϫⲉⲉⲃⲏⲗ ⲉⲟⲩⲗⲁ ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲛⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉϯⲛⲁⲁⲓϥ ϣⲁϯⲁⲗⲟ ⲛⲛⲁϩⲃⲱⲥ ⲉⲡⲓϫⲟⲓ ϯⲛⲁϣⲉ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲥ . ⲥⲁⲧⲟⲧⲥ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲱⲣⲕ ⲁϥⲛⲉϩⲥⲓ ⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ϧⲉⲛϯϫⲓ ⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲉϫⲱⲣϩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ϫⲉⲕⲁⲛ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲱⲣⲕ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲣⲁⲥⲟⲩⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲧⲉⲱⲥ ⲁⲓⲱⲣⲕ ⲙⲡⲓⲁⲛⲁϣ . ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲇⲉ ⲥⲁⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲁϥⲧⲁⲗⲟ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲥⲕⲉⲩⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϥϩⲃⲱⲥ ⲉⲡⲓϫⲟⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲱⲧ ⲉϩⲓⲉⲣⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲏⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲟⲡϥ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲙⲙⲁⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲣⲁϣⲓ ⲛϫⲉϯⲙⲁⲕⲁⲣⲓⲁ ⲙⲉⲗⲁⲛⲏ ϯⲣⲱⲙⲉⲟⲥ . ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲟⲛ ⲁⲡⲓⲇⲓⲁⲃⲟⲗⲟⲥ ϯⲛϣⲟⲧ ⲉⲡⲉϥϩⲏⲧ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲙⲫⲁⲣⲁⲱ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲡⲉϥϩⲏⲧ ϭⲓⲥⲁⲛⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲏⲧ ⲃ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛϯⲙⲉⲧⲁⲗⲟⲩ ⲉⲥⲃⲉⲣⲃⲉⲣ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲓϩⲟⲩⲟ ⲛⲥⲃⲱ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓϫⲓ ⲛϣⲓⲃϯ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓϩⲃⲱⲥ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲓⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲟⲩⲑⲟ ⲛⲣⲏϯ ⲉϥϣⲓⲃϯ ⲛⲥⲟⲡ ⲃ ⲙⲙⲏⲛⲓ ϣⲁⲧⲉϥϩⲉⲓ ⲉϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲉⲟⲩⲙⲉⲧϭⲁⲥⲓϩⲏⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩϩⲩⲇⲟⲛⲏ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲫⲏⲉⲧϣⲱϣⲧⲙⲡⲓⲧⲁⲕⲟ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲛⲉϥⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲁϥⲓⲛⲓ ⲛⲟⲩϫⲟⲥⲉ ⲛϧⲙⲟⲙ ⲛⲁⲣⲟϣ ⲉϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲉϫⲱϥ ϣⲁⲧⲉϥϭⲓⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛⲓⲁⲃⲓ ϣⲁⲧⲉⲧⲉϥⲥⲁⲣⲝ ϣⲙⲁ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲟⲩⲕⲁⲡ ⲑⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲥϯⲛⲁⲓϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉⲧϩⲏⲡ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲡⲁⲑⲟⲥ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲓⲥⲏⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲣⲉⲛⲕⲁⲕⲓⲛ ⲙⲡⲟⲩϣϫⲉⲙϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲧⲁⲗϭⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Then he swore upon the Gospel, saying: ‘After one day, when I have placed my belongings on a ship, I will leave this city.’ As soon as he swore, he awoke from the vision he had seen during the night and said: ‘Even though I swore in a dream, still I have sworn an oath.’ He immediately rose, loaded his belongings and clothing onto a ship, and sailed to Jerusalem. Blessed Melania the Roman received him with joy. Once again, the devil hardened his heart, just as he had once hardened Pharaoh’s. His heart became wavering and conflicted: his youth luxuriated, as did his pride in words and his delight in the changes of fine clothing. He would change them twice a day, succumbing to pride and the pleasures of the body. But God, who always protects his people from ruin, sent him a fever so severe that he endured a prolonged illness, and his flesh became thin as a thread; yet all these pains afflicted him so secretly that doctors, unaware of his illness, were unable to cure him.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲙⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲡⲓⲁⲗⲟⲩ ⲓⲥⲁⲁⲕ ⲁϥϣⲉⲛϥϫⲉⲉⲣⲉⲡⲉⲕⲥⲁϧⲑⲱⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He asked the boy Isaac, 'Where is your master?'
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲁϥⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲥⲁϧϫⲉⲕⲁⲗⲱⲥ ⲡⲓⲣⲉϥϯⲥⲃⲱ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲙⲉⲑⲙⲏⲓ ⲁⲕϫⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲙⲟⲛ ⲕⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉⲃⲏⲗ ⲉⲣⲟϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The scribe said to him, 'Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁϥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲛϫⲉⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲡⲉⲡⲥⲁϧⲙⲡⲓⲥⲗ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲕⲉⲙⲓ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲁⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Jesus answered him, 'Are you the teacher of Israel, and don't understand these things?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲣⲟⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲉϯϩⲁⲡ ⲉⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙⲁϩⲁⲡ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: For what have I to do with also judging those who are outside? Don't you judge those who are within?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϩⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲛⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲉⲥⲱϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲩⲥⲟⲗⲥⲉⲗ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲡⲓϣⲁⲣ ⲛⲧⲉⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ ⲙⲙⲁⲩⲁⲧϥ ⲉⲧⲧⲟⲓ ϩⲓⲱⲧⲟⲩⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛⲇⲉ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲧⲟⲩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲁⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: For they decorate the exterior, like a skin that is clean only on the outside, but not the interior.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲁⲩϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲧⲩⲡⲟⲥ ⲛⲛⲏ ⲁⲩⲥϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁⲛⲉⲩⲥⲃⲱϧⲁⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲡϫⲱⲕ ⲛⲛⲓⲉⲛⲉϩ ⲉⲣⲕⲁⲧⲁⲛⲧⲁⲛ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϩⲟⲛϩⲉⲛ ⲛⲛⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲙⲁⲥⲃⲱ.
bohairic_examples.translation: Command and teach these things.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲃⲱⲕ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲧⲉⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲥϣⲉ ⲛⲁϥ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥⲙⲗⲁϧ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉϥⲟⲓ ⲛⲣⲉⲙⲣⲁⲩϣ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛⲛⲣⲉϥⲥⲃⲱⲛⲣⲉϥⲉⲣⲁⲛⲉⲭ ⲉⲥⲑⲉ ⲙⲡⲓⲡⲉⲧϩⲱⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The Lord's servant must not quarrel, but be gentle towards all, able to teach, patient,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲩⲉⲣⲥⲉⲃⲉⲥⲑⲉ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲉⲫⲗⲏⲟⲩ ⲉⲩϯⲥⲃⲱⲛϩⲁⲛⲥⲃⲱⲛϩⲟⲛϩⲉⲛ ⲛⲣⲱⲙⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩϧⲉⲛⲧⲉϥⲥⲃⲱⲛⲁϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲁⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲛⲓⲥⲁϧ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲉⲙⲟϣⲓ ϧⲉⲛϩⲁⲛⲥⲧⲟⲗⲏ ⲛⲉⲙϩⲁⲛⲁⲥⲡⲁⲥⲙⲟⲥ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲁⲅⲟⲣⲁ
bohairic_examples.translation: In his teaching he said to them, 'Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥϯⲥⲃⲱ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛϩⲁⲛⲙⲏϣ ϧⲉⲛϩⲁⲛⲡⲁⲣⲁⲃⲟⲗⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩϧⲉⲛⲧⲉϥⲥⲃⲱ
bohairic_examples.translation: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϯⲯⲩⲭⲏ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲁⲥⲕⲓⲛ ⲉⲡⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ϩⲱϯ ⲉⲣⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲧⲉⲥϭⲓⲥⲃⲱ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲕⲁϯ ⲉⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲥⲉⲙⲓ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲁⲛⲥⲉⲛⲧⲉⲥϭⲓⲥⲃⲱ ⲛⲑⲟϥ ⲉⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲥⲟⲩⲱ ⲉⲙⲓ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲧⲁϫⲣⲟ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲥⲟⲩⲱϣ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲉⲣⲟⲩⲁⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲁⲓⲃ ⲁⲣⲓⲉⲙⲓ ϫⲉⲉⲥϣⲱⲛⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲗⲓⲃⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: For the soul that practices asceticism in Christ and does not know how to be taught with understanding or to teach what it has firmly learned should be understood to be suffering from madness.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲑⲟⲥ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲥⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲡⲉϫⲁⲥ ⲛⲁϥϫⲉⲥⲉⲡⲁϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲓⲕⲉⲟⲩϩⲱⲣ ⲥⲉⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲉϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲛϯⲧⲣⲁⲡⲉⲍⲁ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲗⲉϥⲗⲓϥⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲁⲗⲱⲟⲩⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But she answered him, 'Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲉϫⲁϥϫⲉⲥⲉϥⲉⲙⲛⲁⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲅⲉⲱⲣⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲅⲣⲏⲅⲟⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲡⲓⲁⲙⲟⲧ ⲡⲓⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲁⲙⲓⲁⲧ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The disciple said: “Yes, there is here Abba Georgios, Abba Gregorios and Abba Piamot, the bishop of Damietta.”
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 3 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:42-48)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁϥⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛϫⲉⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲙⲟⲩ ⲉϥⲙⲏⲣ ⲛⲛⲉϥϭⲁⲗⲁⲩϫ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϥϫⲓϫⲛϩⲁⲛⲥⲉⲃⲉⲛⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϥϩⲟ ⲙⲏⲣ ⲛⲟⲩⲥⲟⲇⲁⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲙⲁϯⲟⲩⲱ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲭⲁϥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲙⲁⲣⲉϥϣⲉ ⲛⲁϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, 'Free him, and let him go.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϫⲉⲟⲩⲏⲓ ⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲁⲕϣⲉⲗⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ⲉⲩⲉϣⲟⲗⲕ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲉⲡⲓⲉⲑⲃⲉϩⲁⲛⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲛⲧⲉϩⲁⲛⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙϯⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲉⲃⲏⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ⲛϧⲏⲧϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the nations that are left shall spoil thee, because of the blood of men, and the sins of the land and city, and of all that dwell in it.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲛⲁⲓⲕⲉⲛⲧⲉ ⲉⲧϩⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉ ⲙⲡⲁⲩϣⲟⲩⲟⲙⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲡⲟⲩⲧϩⲟ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲏⲉⲧⲉ ⲡϭⲥ ϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ϯⲛⲁϯ ⲛⲥⲉⲇⲉⲕⲓⲁⲥ ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲛⲓⲟⲩⲇⲁ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉϥⲉϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲥⲏⲡⲓ ⲛⲓⲗⲏⲙⲛⲏⲉⲑⲛⲁⲥⲉⲡⲓⲉⲡⲁⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ϧⲉⲛⲭⲏⲙⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And as the bad figs, which cannot be eaten, for their badness; thus saith the Lord, So will I deliver Sedekias king of Juda, and his nobles, and the remnant of Jerusalem, them that are left in this land, and the dwellers in Egypt.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲥⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲉⲙⲙⲁⲩ ⲉϥⲉⲟⲩⲁϩⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲛϫⲉⲡϭⲟⲉⲓⲥ ⲉⲧⲁⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲉϥϫⲓϫ ⲉⲑⲣⲉϥⲭⲟϩ ⲉⲡⲥⲱϫⲡ ⲙⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥⲉⲧⲁϥⲥⲉⲡⲓⲫⲏⲉⲑⲛⲁⲥⲱϫⲡ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϩⲁ ⲛⲓⲁⲥⲥⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲭⲏⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲃⲁⲃⲩⲗⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲉⲑⲁⲩϣ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲉⲗⲗⲁⲙⲓⲧⲏⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲉⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲛϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲫⲣⲏ ⲛⲉⲙϯⲁⲣⲁⲃⲓⲁ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And it shall be in that day, that the Lord shall again shew his hand, to be zealous for the remnant that is left of the people, which shall be left by the Assyrians, and that from Egypt, and from the country of Babylon, and from Ethiopia, and from the Elamites, and from the rising of the sun, and out of Arabia.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲟⲩⲱⲙ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲁⲩⲥⲓ.
bohairic_examples.translation: They all ate, and were filled.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱ ⲛⲁϥ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲙⲁⲑⲏⲧⲏⲥ ϫⲉⲛⲓⲙ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲑⲱⲛ ϩⲁⲙⲛⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ϣϫⲟⲙ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲛⲁⲓⲥⲓⲛⲱⲓⲕ ϩⲓⲡϣⲁϥⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: His disciples answered him, 'From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲓⲛⲉϫⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓϩⲏⲕⲓⲥⲏⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But now let the bowels of the poor be satisfied with what belongs to you.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲟⲩⲁϩⲥⲁϩⲛⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲛϣⲟⲣⲡⲉⲥⲉⲕⲉϩⲙⲡⲓⲏⲓ ⲙⲡⲁⲧϥⲓ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲉⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲡⲓϭⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲛⲟⲩϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲩϭⲁϧⲉⲙ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲏ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲏⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁⲛⲁⲓ ⲉϥⲉⲓ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲉϯⲛⲓⲁⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲏⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: And the priest shall give orders to remove the furniture of the house, before the priest comes in to see the plague, and thus none of the things in the house shall become unclean; and afterwards the priest shall go in to examine the house.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲥⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲉⲡⲓⲥⲕⲟⲡⲟⲥ ϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲁⲧⲗⲱⲓϫⲓ ⲉⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲁⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲥϩⲓⲙⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲉϥⲣⲏ ⲥⲛⲥⲁⲃⲉⲛⲥⲉⲗⲥⲓⲗⲙⲙⲁⲓϣⲉⲙⲙⲟ ⲛⲣⲉϥϯⲥⲃⲱ ⲉⲛⲁⲛⲉϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩⲟⲩⲧⲁϩ ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲥⲟⲩⲱⲛⲟⲩ ⲙⲏⲧⲓ ϣⲁⲩⲥⲉⲕ ⲁⲗⲟⲗⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓϩⲁⲛϣⲟⲛϯ ⲓⲉ ϣⲁⲩⲥⲉⲕ ⲕⲉⲛⲧⲉ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϩⲓⲛⲓⲥⲉⲣⲟϫⲓ.
bohairic_examples.translation: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns, or figs from thistles?

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲙⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ϫⲉⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲁⲣⲱⲛ ⲡⲉⲕⲥⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲡⲉⲛⲑⲣⲉϥϣⲉⲛⲁϥ ⲛⲟⲩⲟⲛⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉⲡⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙⲡⲓⲕⲁⲧⲁⲡⲉⲧⲁⲥⲙⲁ ⲛⲁϩⲣⲁϥ ⲛϯⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩ ⲑⲏ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛϯⲕⲩⲃⲱⲧⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϭⲏⲡⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ϯⲛⲁⲟⲩⲟⲩⲛϩⲧϩⲓϫⲉⲛϯⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩ
bohairic_examples.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Speak to Aaron thy brother, and let him not come in at all times into the holy place within the veil before the propitiatory, which is upon the ark of the testimony, and he shall not die; for I will appear in a cloud on the propitiatory.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩ ⲛϫⲉⲁⲁⲣⲱⲛ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛⲛⲓⲧⲁⲡ ⲛⲧⲉϯϣⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲥⲟⲡ ⲛϯⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩⲟⲩⲥⲟⲡ ⲛϯⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉϥⲉⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟϥ ϣⲁⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲉⲁ ⲡⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲙⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲡⲉ
bohairic_examples.translation: And once in the year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns, he shall purge it with the blood of purification for their generations: it is most holy to the Lord.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϧⲉⲛⲡϫⲓⲛⲓ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲛⲧⲉⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ⲉϯⲥⲕⲩⲛⲏ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲙⲉⲧⲙⲉⲑⲣⲉ ⲉⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲉϯⲥⲙⲏ ⲛⲧⲉⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲉⲥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲥⲁⲡϣⲱⲓⲛϯⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩϧⲉⲛⲧⲙⲏϯ ⲙⲡⲓⲭⲉⲣⲟⲩⲃⲓⲙ ⲃ ⲛⲏ ⲉⲧϩⲓϫⲉⲛ ⲛϯⲕⲩⲃⲱⲧⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲙⲉⲧⲙⲉⲑⲣⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϣⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲛϫⲉⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ
bohairic_examples.translation: When Moses went into the tabernacle of witness to speak to God, then he heard the voice of the Lord speaking to him from off the mercy-seat, which is upon the ark of the testimony, between the two cherubs; and he spoke to him.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲙⲉⲛⲉⲛⲥⲁⲡⲉϥⲣⲁⲥϯ ⲡⲉϫⲉ ⲙⲱⲩⲥⲏⲥ ⲙⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲣⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϯⲛⲟⲩ ϯⲛⲁϣⲉⲛⲏⲓ ⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ϩⲁⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ϩⲓⲛⲁⲛⲧⲁⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩⲉϫⲉⲛⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲛⲟⲃⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: And it came to pass after the morrow had begun, that Moses said to the people, Ye have sinned a great sin; and now I will go up to God, that I may make atonement for your sin.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲱⲗⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲙⲁⲥⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲛⲟⲩϫϧ ⲛⲧⲉϥϫⲓϫ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛϯⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩ ⲥⲁ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲛϣⲁⲓ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟⲛϯⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩⲛⲍ ⲛⲥⲟⲡ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲧⲏⲃ
bohairic_examples.translation: And he shall take of the blood of the calf, and sprinkle with his finger on the mercy-seat eastward: before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle seven times of the blood with his finger.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉϥⲉⲧⲁⲗⲟ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲑⲩⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲡⲓⲭⲣⲱⲙ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟ ⲙⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲣⲉⲡⲓⲭⲣⲉⲙⲧⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲥⲑⲩⲛⲟⲩϥⲓ ⲉϥⲉϩⲱⲃⲥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗⲉϫⲉⲛϯⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩⲉⲧⲭⲏ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛⲛⲓⲙⲉⲧⲙⲉⲑⲣⲉⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲙⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: And he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord, and the smoke of the incense shall cover the mercy-seat over the tables of testimony, and he shall not die.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉϧⲟⲗϧⲉⲗ ⲙⲡⲓⲃⲁⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲧⲉⲉⲑⲃⲉⲫⲛⲟⲃⲓ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥϭⲓⲧϥ ⲛⲧⲟⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟ ⲙⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲥⲁϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲙⲡⲓⲕⲁⲧⲁⲡⲉⲧⲁⲥⲙⲁ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲙⲡⲓⲙⲁⲥⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲛⲟⲩϫϧ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲡⲓⲩⲗⲁⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ ⲙⲡⲉⲙⲑⲟ ⲙⲡϩⲟⲛϯⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩ
bohairic_examples.translation: And he shall kill the goat for the sin-offering that is for the people, before the Lord; and he shall bring in of its blood within the veil, and shall do with its blood as he did with the blood of the calf, and shall sprinkle its blood on the mercy-seat, in front of the mercy-seat.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩ ⲛϫⲉⲁⲁⲣⲱⲛ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛⲛⲓⲧⲁⲡ ⲛⲧⲉϯϣⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲥⲟⲡ ⲛϯⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲛⲟⲃⲓⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲥⲉⲥⲃⲟϩⲟⲩⲥⲟⲡ ⲛϯⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉϥⲉⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟϥ ϣⲁⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲅⲉⲛⲉⲁ ⲡⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲙⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲡⲉ
bohairic_examples.translation: And once in the year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns, he shall purge it with the blood of purification for their generations: it is most holy to the Lord.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁϥϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲫⲣⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲓⲓⲟϩ ⲁϥⲟϩⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲧϥ ⲉⲧⲉϥⲧⲁⲝⲓⲥ ⲉⲩⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲩⲉⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲉⲕⲥⲟⲑⲛⲉϥ ⲉⲩⲙⲟⲩⲉⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲕⲥⲉⲧⲉⲃⲣⲏϫⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲕϩⲟⲡⲗⲟⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The sun was exalted, and the moon stood still in her course: thy darts shall go forth at the light, at the brightness of the gleaming of thine arms.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲁϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛϩⲣⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲧⲫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲓⲛⲓ ⲛⲛⲓϭⲏⲡⲓ ⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛ ⲁⲑⲣⲏϫϥ ⲙⲡⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲑⲁⲙⲓⲟⲛϩⲁⲛⲥⲉⲧⲉⲃⲣⲏϫⲉϩⲁⲛⲙⲟⲩⲛϩⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲓⲛⲓ ⲙⲓⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲉϥⲁϩⲱⲣ .
bohairic_examples.translation: and set abundance of waters in the sky, and brought up clouds from the ends of the earth; he made lightnings for the rain, and brought forth light out of his treasures.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲡϭⲥ ⲉϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲉϫⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩⲥⲟⲑⲛⲉϥ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯⲛⲟⲩⲥⲉⲧⲉⲃⲣⲏϫⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡϭⲥ ⲡⲓⲡⲁⲛⲧⲟⲕⲣⲁⲧⲱⲣ ⲉϥⲉⲉⲣⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲍⲓⲛ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲥⲁⲗⲡⲓⲅⲝ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲙⲟϣⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲙⲟⲛⲙⲉⲛ ⲛⲧⲉⲟⲩϫⲱⲛⲧ .
bohairic_examples.translation: And the Lord shall be over them, and his arrow shall go forth as lightning: and the Lord Almighty shall blow with the trumpet; and shall proceed with the tumult of his threatening.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲁⲧⲟⲧϥⲁⲡⲓⲥⲉϩⲧϣⲉ ⲛⲁϥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲓⲱⲧϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲧⲟⲩⲃⲟ .
bohairic_examples.translation: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲥⲉϩⲧϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϩⲃⲱⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲏⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: and of the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲥϩⲓⲙⲓ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲉϥⲛⲁϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩϭⲟϩⲛⲧⲉⲟⲩⲥⲉϩⲧϧⲉⲛϯⲁⲫⲉ ⲓⲉ ϯⲙⲟⲣⲧ
bohairic_examples.translation: And if a man or a woman have in them a plague of leprosy in the head or the beard;

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉⲡⲥⲏⲟⲩⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲡⲓϣⲱⲙ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲉⲙⲙⲁⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: For it was the summer at that time.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲙⲡⲉⲣϯ ⲕⲉⲏⲓ ϫⲉ ⲛϯⲙⲉⲧⲣⲁⲙⲁⲟ ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲛⲁⲕⲓⲣⲓ ⲙⲙⲟⲥⲛⲟⲩⲥⲏⲟⲩⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙⲁⲗⲗⲟⲛ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲥⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ ⲛⲧⲟⲧⲕ ⲛϫⲉϯⲙⲉⲧⲙⲁⲓϩⲁⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲑⲟⲕ ϩⲱⲕ ⲛⲧⲉⲕⲙⲟⲩⲛⲕ ⲛⲧⲟⲧⲥ
bohairic_examples.translation: Do not, as you once did, build yourself another house from wealth, but rather let the desire for silver abandon you, and you abandon it.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲟⲩϩⲟⲣⲁⲥⲓⲥ ⲧⲉⲛⲧⲉⲟⲩⲥⲏⲟⲩⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲥⲉⲉⲣⲟⲩⲱⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲩϧⲁⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉⲧϣⲟⲩⲓⲧ ⲁⲛ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲁϥϣⲁⲛϭⲓϩⲟ ϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ϧⲁϫⲱϥ ϫⲉϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲓ ϥⲛⲁⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲱⲥⲕ .
bohairic_examples.translation: For the vision is yet for a time, and it shall shoot forth at the end, and not in vain: though he should tarry, wait for him; for he will surely come, and will not tarry.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲟϩⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲧⲟⲩⲁϥⲑⲉⲕⲉⲙϯⲥⲏϥⲓⲉⲁϥϯ ⲛⲟⲩϣⲁϣ ⲙⲫⲃⲱⲕ ⲙⲡⲓⲁⲣⲭⲓⲉⲣⲉⲩⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲱⲗⲓ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲙⲁϣϫ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲇⲉ ⲁⲓⲱⲗⲓⲛⲧⲁⲥⲏϥⲓⲁⲓϭⲟϫⲓ ⲥⲁⲫⲁϩⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲁⲓϧⲟⲑⲃϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛϯⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ ⲁⲓⲕⲱϯ ϧⲉⲛϯⲁⲥⲟⲩⲓ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲙⲟⲩⲧ ⲉⲓⲙⲉⲩⲓ ϫⲉϯⲛⲁϫⲓⲙⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲛⲓⲇⲟⲥ ⲛⲛⲟⲩⲃ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲥ ⲛⲧⲁⲟⲗⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲁⲟⲩⲛⲟϥ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲛϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: I noticed it and, driven by greed, I grabbed my sword, pursued him, and struck him down. I searched the pouch, expecting to discover a large sum in gold that would allow me to live in ease for years.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϧⲁⲛⲓⲉⲑⲁⲩϣ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϩⲁⲛϧⲱⲧⲉⲃⲛⲧⲉⲧⲁⲥⲏϥⲓ.
bohairic_examples.translation: Ye Ethiopians also are the slain of my sword.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉⲁⲡⲟⲩⲣⲟ ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥϩⲏⲧ ϫⲉⲙⲡⲓⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲉϥⲛⲁⲫⲟϩ ϣⲁⲣⲟϥ ⲛⲧⲉϥⲱⲗⲓ ⲛⲧⲉϥⲁⲫⲉϧⲉⲛⲧⲥⲏϥⲓ. ⲟⲩⲟϩ
bohairic_examples.translation: The king had resolved in his heart to take off the archbishop's head with his sword, as soon as he should have come near him.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 3 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:42-48)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲩⲉϩⲱⲙⲓ ⲉⲛⲉⲡⲗⲁⲧⲓⲁ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲏⲃ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉϥϩⲑⲱⲣ ⲡⲉⲙⲏϣ ϥⲛⲁϧⲟⲑⲃϥϧⲉⲛⲧⲥⲏϥⲓⲡϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲟⲩϫⲟⲙ ϥⲛⲁⲉⲛϥ ⲉⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ .
bohairic_examples.translation: With the hoofs of his horses they shall trample all thy streets: he shall slay thy people with the sword, and shall bring down to the ground the support of thy strength.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲭⲱ ⲛⲣⲱⲓ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯⲛⲟⲩⲥⲏϥⲓⲉⲥϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲭⲟⲡⲧ ϧⲁⲧⲥⲕⲏⲡⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲉϥϫⲓϫ ⲁϥⲭⲁⲧ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲛⲟⲩⲥⲟⲑⲛⲉϥ ⲉϥⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲥⲕⲉⲡⲁⲍⲓⲛ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲙⲟⲕⲓ ⲛⲭⲁⲥⲟⲑⲛⲉϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: and he has made my mouth as a sharp sword, and he has hid me under the shadow of his hand; he has made me as a choice shaft, and he has hid me in his quiver;

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲫⲓⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲟⲛ ϣϫⲟⲙ ⲉϩⲱⲃ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ϧⲁⲧⲟⲧⲕ ⲙⲁⲣⲉⲡⲓⲁⲫⲟⲧⲥⲓⲛⲓⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲣⲟⲓ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲉϩⲛⲏⲓ ⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲁⲛ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲙⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲉϩⲛⲁⲕ ⲛⲑⲟⲕ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He said, 'Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩⲧϩⲉⲙⲕⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓϫⲓⲛⲥⲱⲕ ⲛⲁⲣⲉⲡⲓⲑⲏⲟⲩ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉϩⲣⲁⲩ ⲡⲉ ⲛϩⲣⲏⲓ ⲇⲉ ϧⲉⲛϯⲙⲁϩⲇ ⲛⲟⲩⲉⲣϣⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲉϫⲱⲣϩ ⲁϥⲓ ϩⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲉϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛⲫⲓⲟⲙ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥⲟⲩⲱϣⲉⲥⲉⲛⲟⲩⲡⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and he would have passed by them,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩⲉϥⲥⲓⲛⲓⲱⲟⲩⲁϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲗⲉⲩⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲁⲗⲫⲉⲟⲥ ⲉϥϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ϩⲓⲡⲓⲧⲉⲗⲱⲛⲓⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛⲥⲱⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲧⲱⲛϥ ⲁϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲛⲥⲱϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, 'Follow me.' And he arose and followed him.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲧⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲓⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲥⲉⲛⲁⲥⲓⲛⲓ ⲛⲁⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲇⲉⲛⲛⲟⲩⲥⲓⲛⲓ.
bohairic_examples.translation: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲧⲟⲧⲉ ⲉϥⲉⲟⲩⲱⲧⲉⲃ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲉϥⲉⲥⲓⲛⲓⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥⲉⲭⲱ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲑⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ϯϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲁⲛⲟⲩϯ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Then shall he change his spirit, and he shall pass through, and make an atonement, saying, This strength belongs to my god.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲓⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲉⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲱ ⲛⲁⲓⲟϯ ϯϯϩⲟ ⲉⲣⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲙⲡⲣⲭⲁϩⲑⲏⲧⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲁⲓⲙⲉⲧⲣⲁⲙⲁⲟ ⲉⲧⲉⲛⲥⲙⲟⲛⲧ ⲁⲛ ⲟⲩⲇⲉ ⲙⲡⲣϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲱⲧⲉⲛ ϩⲓⲧⲉⲛⲡⲁϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛϩⲩⲡⲁⲣⲭⲟⲛⲧⲁ ϫⲉⲛⲁⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩⲥⲉⲛⲁⲥⲓⲛⲓⲛⲭⲱⲗⲉⲙ
bohairic_examples.translation: And these are the words he said to them: ‘O my parents, I beseech you, do not rest your hearts on these unstable riches; do not glory in the abundance of your goods, they will pass away quickly.
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩⲉⲧⲁϥⲥⲓⲛⲓⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁ ⲫⲓⲟⲙ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲅⲁⲗⲓⲗⲉⲁ ⲁϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛⲇⲣⲉⲁⲥ ⲡⲥⲟⲛ ⲛⲥⲓⲙⲱⲛ ⲉⲩϩⲓϣⲛⲉ ⲛⲥⲓϯ ⲉⲫⲓⲟⲙ ϫⲉⲟⲩⲏⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲉϩⲁⲛⲟⲩⲟϩⲓ ⲛⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲉϫⲉⲡⲓⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲓϩⲉⲙⲥⲓ ϣⲁⲧⲉⲛⲡⲓϭⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲁϯⲙⲓ ⲁⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓⲥⲓⲛⲓⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲉⲣⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲁⲥⲟⲩⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲙⲟⲩⲧ
bohairic_examples.translation: The man responded, ‘One day I was sitting near the threshing floor of my village when someone passed by on a mule.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲉⲙⲙⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲁⲣⲟⲩϩⲓ ϣⲱⲡⲓϫⲉⲙⲁⲣⲉⲛⲥⲓⲛⲓⲉⲙⲏⲣ
bohairic_examples.translation: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, 'Let's go over to the other side.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩⲛⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩⲉⲩⲉϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲩϩⲓⲱⲟⲩⲧ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲧⲫⲉ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲫⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲉⲩⲉⲕⲓⲙ
bohairic_examples.translation: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲓⲉϯ ⲛⲁϥⲙⲡⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩⲉϣⲁϥϣⲁⲓ ⲛⲧⲟⲟⲩⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: and I will give him the morning star.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲉⲧⲡⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲫⲣⲏ ⲟⲩⲉⲧⲡⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲓⲓⲟϩ ⲟⲩⲉⲧⲡⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲛⲓⲥⲓⲟⲩⲟⲩⲟⲛⲟⲩⲥⲓⲟⲩⲅⲁⲣ ⲉϥⲟⲩⲟⲧ ⲉⲥⲓⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥⲱⲟⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲑⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲟⲗⲥ ⲛⲁⲩⲉⲣⲃⲟⲏⲑⲓⲛ ⲉⲩⲙⲟⲩⲣ ⲙⲡⲓϫⲟⲉⲓ ⲉⲩⲉⲣϩⲟϯ ⲇⲉ ⲙⲏⲡⲱⲥ ⲛⲥⲉϩⲉⲓ ⲉϧⲣⲏⲓⲉϯⲥⲓⲣⲧⲏⲥⲁⲛⲭⲱ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲕⲉⲩⲟⲥ ⲉⲡⲉⲥⲏⲧ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲁⲛⲗⲱⲓⲗⲓ .

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩϭⲏⲡⲓ ⲉⲥⲉⲣϧⲏⲓⲃⲓ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓⲛϫⲉⲟⲩⲥⲙⲏⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛϯϭⲏⲡⲓ ϫⲉⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲁϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲡⲁⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲛⲥⲱϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, 'This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲩⲉⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟⲕ ⲉⲩⲉϯⲛⲁⲕϩⲓ ⲛϫⲉϩⲁⲛⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲉϥⲉϫⲱⲣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉϥⲙⲱⲓⲧ ⲙⲙⲟϣⲓ ⲫⲛⲟⲩⲛ ⲁϥϯⲛⲧⲉϥⲥⲙⲏⲉⲡϭⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉϥϩⲟⲣⲧϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: The nations shall see thee and be in pain, as thou dost divide the moving waters: the deep uttered her voice, and raised her form on high.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲇⲉ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲙⲟⲩϯ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯⲛⲥⲙⲏⲁϥϯ ⲙⲡⲓⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ
bohairic_examples.translation: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲉϫⲏⲓ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲛⲁⲓⲟⲩⲱϣ ϩⲱ ⲡⲉ ⲉⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲛⲧⲉϥⲥⲙⲟⲩⲉⲣⲟⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: I said, ‘I long to see him, that I too might receive his blessing.’

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲧⲉⲛϧⲟⲥⲓ ⲉⲛⲉⲣϩⲱⲃ ⲛⲛⲉⲛϫⲓϫ ⲙⲙⲓⲛⲙⲙⲟⲛ ⲥⲉϩⲱⲟⲩϣ ⲉⲣⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟϩⲧⲉⲛⲥⲙⲟⲩⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲩϭⲟϫⲓ ⲛⲥⲱⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲛϩⲏⲧ .
bohairic_examples.translation: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁϥϣⲉ ⲛⲁϥ ⲉⲡⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛⲧⲉϣⲓⲏⲧ ⲫⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲟⲩϣⲟⲡ ⲛϫⲉ ϩⲁⲛⲭⲱⲣⲟⲥ ⲛⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ⲉⲩⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛⲧⲉⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲧⲉⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥⲉⲧⲥⲙⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩⲧⲛⲁⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲉⲣⲥⲧⲁⲩⲣⲱⲛⲉⲓⲛ ⲛⲧⲟⲩⲥⲁⲣⲝ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓϧⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲁⲣⲉⲧⲏ ⲉⲩϥⲁⲓ ϧⲁⲫⲙⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲥⲏⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲟⲩⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲉⲩⲉⲣϩⲉⲗⲡⲓⲥ ⲉⲡⲓⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲛⲁϭⲱⲣⲡ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲥϧⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲓⲥϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲛϭⲓⲙⲕⲁϩ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲧⲉⲛⲛⲁϭⲓⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲟⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He went to the holy mountain of Skete, where dwell the choirs of the holy angels of God, that is, of the blessed monks who have crucified their flesh in the sufferings of virtue, who endure at all times the death of Jesus in their bodies, hoping for the glory that will be manifested to them, as it is written: ‘If we have suffered with him, we will also be glorified with him.’
bohairic_examples.source: Life of Isaac of Alexandria - part 1 (urn:cts:copticLit:lives.boh_isaac.amelineau_ed:1-19)

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲉⲣⲉϩⲁⲛⲥⲁⲛⲇⲁⲗⲓⲟⲛ ⲧⲟⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲧ ⲉⲛⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲙⲡⲉⲣϯϣⲑⲏⲛⲥⲛⲟⲩϯϩⲓⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϣⲱⲡ ⲛⲧⲉⲧⲉⲕϫⲓϫ ⲉⲣⲥⲕⲁⲛⲇⲁⲗⲓⲍⲉⲥⲑⲉ ⲙⲙⲟⲕ ϫⲟϫⲥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲁⲛⲉⲥ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲛⲧⲉⲕⲓ ⲉϧⲟⲩⲛ ⲉⲡⲓⲱⲛϧ ⲉⲕⲟⲓ ⲛϫⲁϭⲏ ⲓⲉ ⲉⲣⲉϫⲓϫⲥⲛⲟⲩϯⲉⲣⲟⲕ ⲛⲧⲉⲕϣⲉ ⲉϯⲅⲉⲉⲛⲛⲁ ⲉⲡⲓⲭⲣⲱⲙ ⲛⲁⲧϭⲉⲛⲟ .
bohairic_examples.translation: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲧⲁⲥⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩⲭⲏⲣⲁ ⲛϩⲏⲕⲓ ⲁⲥϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲃⲓⲥⲛⲟⲩϯⲉⲧⲉⲟⲩⲕⲟⲛⲇⲣⲁⲛⲧⲏⲥ ⲡⲉ
bohairic_examples.translation: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲥⲉⲁⲙⲟⲛⲓⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟⲩϯⲉⲧⲉⲡⲓⲑⲩⲙⲓⲁ ⲉⲥⲉⲛⲧⲟⲧ ⲉⲃⲱⲗ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲧⲁϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲛϩⲟⲩⲟ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲁⲗⲗⲟⲛ ϥⲥⲟⲧⲡ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But I am in a dilemma between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉϭⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲟⲩϣⲟⲗ ⲛϩⲩⲥⲱⲡⲟⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲥⲱⲡ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧϧⲁⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲣⲟ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲗⲁⲗⲉ ⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲑⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙϯⲟⲩⲉϫⲣⲟⲥⲛⲟⲩϯⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲥⲛⲟϥ ⲉⲧϧⲁⲧⲉⲛ ⲡⲓⲣⲟ ⲛⲑⲱⲧⲉⲛ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲫⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲙⲫⲣⲟ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉϥⲏⲓ ϣⲁϩⲁⲛⲁⲧⲟⲟⲩⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and having dipped it into some of the blood that is by the door, ye shall touch the lintel, and shall put it upon both door-posts, even of the blood which is by the door; but ye shall not go out every one from the door of his house till the morning.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲑⲟϥ ⲇⲉ ⲙⲡⲉϥϥⲁⲓ ⲛϫⲱϥ ⲉⲡϣⲱⲓ ⲉϥⲉⲣϩⲱⲃ ⲁⲗⲗⲁ ⲡⲉϫⲁϥ ⲛⲏⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲥⲙⲏ ⲉⲥⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϫⲉⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲣⲉⲧⲏⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ϥⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛⲧⲟⲩⲏⲡⲓ ϥⲉⲣⲛⲭⲣⲓⲁ ⲁⲛ ϩⲓⲛⲁ ⲛⲧⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ϣⲓⲧⲟⲩ ⲛⲁϥ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥϣⲓ ⲛⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲕⲁⲗⲁⲙⲫⲟ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲙⲁ ϣⲓ ϥⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲧⲉⲙⲓ ⲁⲛ ⲉⲡϣⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉϩⲁⲧ . ⲉⲛⲁⲣⲉϯ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲛⲏⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲓⲉ ⲕⲁⲗⲱⲥ ⲧⲉⲧⲁⲙⲟ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ϩⲱⲥ ⲉⲁⲛⲟⲕ ⲟⲩⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲓⲥϫⲉ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲉⲣⲉϯ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲙⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲓⲉ ⲟⲩⲧⲉ ϯⲭⲣⲓⲁ ϫⲉⲧⲉⲧⲁⲙⲟ ⲙⲙⲟⲓ ⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲫⲏ ⲉⲧⲁϥϣⲱⲡ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲛϯⲧⲉⲃⲓⲥⲛⲟⲩϯⲛⲧⲉϯⲭⲏⲣⲁ ϥⲛⲁϣⲱⲡ ⲉⲣⲟϥ ⲙⲡⲉϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ϩⲱⲓ ⲭⲁⲣⲱ ⲛⲑⲟ ⲙⲡⲉⲣϣⲟⲩϣⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲟ .
bohairic_examples.translation: But he, not even lifting his head as he wove the palms, said to me in a firm voice: “He to whom you have given this knows its amount; there is no need for anyone to tell him the quantity. For He who weighs mountains and hills with a scale is not ignorant of the quantity of silver. If you had told me this, you would have done well to remind me, for I am a man; but when you have given it to God, what need is there to inform me? For the God who accepted the widow’s two small coins will also accept your offering. But you should be silent, lest you boast.”

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩⲟⲩⲱⲛ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲉϥⲙⲁϣϫ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϯⲟⲩⲱⲛϫⲉⲡⲓⲥⲛⲁϩⲛⲧⲉⲡⲉϥⲗⲁⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥⲥⲁϫⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲉϥⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ
bohairic_examples.translation: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲑⲁⲓ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲑⲟⲥ ⲟⲩϣⲉⲣⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲁⲃⲣⲁⲁⲙ ⲧⲉ ⲉⲁ ⲡⲥⲁⲧⲁⲛⲁⲥ ⲥⲟⲛϩⲥ ⲓⲥ ⲓⲏ ⲛⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲛⲉⲡⲉⲧⲥϣⲉ ⲁⲛ ⲡⲉ ⲉⲃⲟⲗⲥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗϧⲉⲛⲡⲁⲓⲥⲛⲁϩϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲙⲡⲥⲁⲃⲃⲁⲧⲟⲛ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲡⲓϩⲛⲓⲙ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲁϥⲑⲏϣ ⲛⲁϥ ⲡⲉ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲉϥⲉⲛⲕⲟⲧ ⲇⲉ ⲡⲓⲣⲉⲅ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲉϫⲱⲣϩ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲉϩⲟⲟⲩ ⲇⲉ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲁϥⲛⲕⲟⲧ ⲉⲡⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲡⲉ ⲛⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲟⲩⲟⲛϩ ⲛⲧⲁϥ ⲡⲉ ⲉϥⲓⲣⲓ ⲛϯⲁⲛⲁⲙⲉⲣⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲥⲉϥⲥⲛⲏⲓⲛⲓⲛϧⲏⲧϥ ⲉϥⲃⲟⲣⲃⲉⲣ ⲙⲡⲓϩⲛⲓⲙ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲣⲟϥ ⲉϥⲑⲣⲟ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲕⲁϯ ⲉⲙⲟⲩϣⲧ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓϫⲓⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲥⲙⲟⲛⲧ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲉϫⲱⲣϧ ⲇⲉ ⲁϥϣⲁⲛⲕⲏⲛ ⲉϥⲉⲛⲕⲟⲧ ⲙⲡⲓⲣⲉⲅ ϣⲁϥϭⲉⲡⲥⲱϫⲛ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥⲙⲟϣⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲟⲛϩ ⲉϥⲉⲣⲙⲉⲗⲉⲧⲏ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉϥϣⲗⲏⲗ ⲉϥⲥⲱⲣ ⲙⲡⲓϩⲛⲓⲙ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϩⲁⲣⲟϥ ⲉϥⲑⲣⲟ ⲙⲡⲉϥⲕⲁϯ ⲉⲙⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲛⲛⲓϫⲓⲛⲛⲁⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲅⲣⲁⲫⲏ ⲁϥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲉⲣⲉⲡⲉϥⲕⲁϯ ⲧⲟⲩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲧ ⲉⲙⲁϣⲱ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲉⲣⲡⲉⲙⲡϣⲁ ⲛⲟⲩϩⲙⲟⲧ ⲛⲧⲉⲟⲩⲥⲟⲫⲓⲁ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲉⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲇⲓⲁⲕⲣⲏⲥⲓⲥ ⲉϥⲫⲱⲣϫ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲛⲓϩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲓⲇⲁⲓⲙⲱⲛ . ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲁϥⲟⲓ ⲛⲁⲕⲣⲓⲃⲏⲥ ⲡⲉ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲅⲣⲁⲫⲏ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲉⲙⲁϣⲱ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲟⲥⲓⲥ ⲉⲧⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲕⲁⲑⲟⲗⲓⲕⲏ ⲛⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ ⲕⲉ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲥⲉⲉⲣⲙⲉⲑⲣⲉ ϧⲁⲧⲉϥⲥⲃⲱ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉϥⲉⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉϥⲕⲁϯ ⲛⲥⲟⲧⲡ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓϫⲱⲙ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲥϧⲏⲧⲟⲩ . ⲁϥⲥϧⲉⲅ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛϫⲱⲙ ⲛⲥⲃⲱ ⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲛⲓⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥ ⲛⲁⲟⲩⲃⲏⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲕⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲛⲓⲙⲟⲛⲁⲭⲟⲥ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲣⲓ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲉϥϣⲁϥⲉ ⲛⲉⲙⲕⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲉⲑⲃⲉⲛⲓⲟⲩⲏⲃ ⲛⲧⲉⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲉⲑⲣⲟⲩⲣⲱⲓⲥ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲡⲓⲙⲁ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ . ⲉⲣⲉⲡⲓⲅ ϯⲥⲃⲱ ⲛⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉϯϫⲓ ⲛⲱⲛϧ ⲉⲧⲉⲣⲛⲟϥⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙϯϫⲓ ⲛⲕⲁϯ ⲉⲧⲥⲙⲟⲛⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲓϫⲓⲛ ⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲧⲥⲟⲩⲧⲱⲛ ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲛⲓⲡⲁⲣⲁⲇⲟⲥⲓⲥ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲉⲕⲕⲗⲏⲥⲓⲁ ⲛⲉ ⲑⲁⲓ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉϥⲥⲩⲛⲏⲑⲓⲁ .
bohairic_examples.translation: His sleep, however, was measured and divided: he slept for a third of the night, but never during the day. He had a corridor where, throughout the entire half of the day, he walked, weighed down with drowsiness, forcing his mind to contemplate visions that were revealed to him. At night, when he had already slept for a third of the night, he would spend the remaining part of the night walking through the corridor, meditating and praying, driving sleep away from himself, and compelling his mind to focus on the visions of the Scriptures. Thus, he became a man of the purest mind and of wisdom, knowledge, and discernment, and he was regarded as worthy of the grace of discretion, distinguishing the works of demons. In the holy Scriptures and the orthodoxy of the Catholic Church, he was eloquent and learned, for his knowledge and his chosen mind are attested to by the books he wrote. He wrote three books: one about the monks of monasteries, another about the monks who dwelled in the cells of his desert, and another about the presbyters of God, to make them vigilant in their holy place. These three books all taught a good life, ordered understanding, and visions in accordance with the orthodox traditions of the Church. For this was his custom.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛϫⲉⲓⲥⲁⲁⲕⲉⲥⲛⲏⲓⲛⲓϧⲉⲛⲧⲕⲟⲓ ⲙⲫⲛⲁⲩ ⲛⲣⲟⲩϩⲓ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁϥϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲛⲛⲉϥⲃⲁⲗ ⲁϥⲛⲁⲩ ⲉϩⲁⲛϫⲁⲙⲁⲩⲗⲓ ⲉⲩⲛⲏⲟⲩ
bohairic_examples.translation: And Isaac went forth into the plain toward evening to meditate; and having lifted up his eyes, he saw camels coming.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲓⲥ ⲟⲩⲥϩⲓⲙⲓ ⲁⲥⲉⲣⲓⲃ ⲛⲣⲟⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲣⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛⲟⲩⲥⲛⲟϥϧⲁⲣⲟⲥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: A certain woman, who had an issue of blood for twelve years,

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁϥϫⲟⲥ ⲛⲱⲟⲩ ϫⲉⲡϩⲁⲓ ⲡⲉⲡⲁⲥⲛⲟϥⲛⲧⲉϯⲇⲓⲁⲑⲏⲕⲏ ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲛⲁⲫⲟⲛϥ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲉⲡϫⲓⲛⲭⲱ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲛⲟⲃⲓ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He said to them, 'This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ϫⲉⲟⲩⲏⲓ ⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲁⲕϣⲉⲗⲟⲩⲙⲏϣ ⲛⲉⲑⲛⲟⲥ ⲉⲩⲉϣⲟⲗⲕ ⲛϫⲉⲛⲓⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲉⲡⲓⲉⲑⲃⲉϩⲁⲛⲥⲛⲟϥⲛⲧⲉϩⲁⲛⲣⲱⲙⲓ ⲛⲉⲙϯⲙⲉⲧⲁⲥⲉⲃⲏⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲛⲧⲉϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲉⲧϣⲟⲡ ⲛϧⲏⲧϥ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the nations that are left shall spoil thee, because of the blood of men, and the sins of the land and city, and of all that dwell in it.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲕⲉⲥⲉⲛϯⲅⲁⲣ ⲙⲙⲟⲛ ϣϫⲟⲙ ⲛⲧⲉⲕⲉⲟⲩⲁⲓ ⲭⲁⲥ ⲉϧⲣⲏⲓ ⲥⲁⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲑⲏ ⲉⲧⲭⲏ ⲉⲧⲉⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲡⲭⲣⲓⲥⲧⲟⲥ ⲡⲉ .
bohairic_examples.translation: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲁⲕⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲉⲩⲟⲩϫⲁⲓ ⲙⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ ⲉⲑⲣⲉⲕⲧⲟⲩϫⲟ ⲛⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲕⲑⲁϩⲥⲟⲩ ⲁⲕϩⲓⲟⲩⲓ ⲛⲟⲩⲙⲟⲩ ⲉϫⲉⲛⲧⲁⲫⲉ ⲛⲛⲓⲁⲛⲟⲙⲟⲥ ⲁⲕⲭⲱⲛϯⲥⲉⲛϯⲉⲥϣⲟⲩⲓⲧ ⲁⲕⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲥⲛⲉⲕⲥⲛⲁⲩϩ ϣⲁⲛⲙⲟϯ ⲇⲓⲁⲯⲁⲗⲙⲁ .
bohairic_examples.translation: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, to save thine anointed: thou shalt bring death on the heads of transgressors; thou has brought bands upon their neck. Pause.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉϥⲥⲉⲛϯϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲧⲱⲟⲩ ⲉⲑⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲙⲉⲓ ⲛⲛⲓⲡⲩⲗⲏ ⲛⲧⲉⲥⲓⲱⲛ ⲉϩⲟⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲙⲁⲛϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ⲛⲧⲉⲓⲁⲕⲱⲃ
bohairic_examples.translation: His foundations are in the holy mountains.

senses: become, be ready, prepare, set in order

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲕⲁⲧⲁⲫⲣⲏϯ ⲉⲧⲥϧⲏⲟⲩⲧ ϧⲉⲛⲏⲥⲁⲓⲁⲥ ⲡⲓⲡⲣⲟⲫⲏⲧⲏⲥ ϫⲉϩⲏⲡⲡⲉ ϯⲛⲁⲟⲩⲱⲣⲡ ⲙⲡⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲟⲥ ϧⲁⲧϩⲏ ⲙⲡⲉⲕϩⲟ ⲫⲏⲉⲑⲛⲁⲥⲟⲃϯⲙⲡⲉⲕⲙⲱⲓⲧ ϧⲁϫⲱⲕ .
bohairic_examples.translation: As it is written in the prophets; Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲁⲗⲓⲛϫⲉⲥⲉⲃⲧⲉⲛⲉⲧⲉⲛϩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓϧⲉⲛⲡⲉⲧⲉⲛϫⲓⲛⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲙⲁ
bohairic_examples.translation: And again: “Prepare your works for the departure of your soul from the body.”

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲑⲟϥ ϥⲛⲁⲧⲁⲙⲉⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩ ⲉⲟⲩⲛⲓϣϯ ⲙⲙⲁ ⲉϥϭⲟⲥⲓ ⲉϥⲫⲟⲣϣⲉϥⲥⲉⲃⲧⲱⲧⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲉⲃⲧⲱⲧϥ ⲛⲁⲛ ⲙⲙⲁⲩ .
bohairic_examples.translation: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Make ready for us there.'

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲟⲩⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩⲛⲉⲙⲡⲟⲩⲥⲟⲃϯⲧⲏⲣϥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲛⲟⲩϩⲓⲟⲙⲓ ⲁⲩⲉⲣⲉⲭⲙⲁⲗⲱⲧⲉⲩⲓⲛ ⲙⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲩϩⲱⲗⲉⲙ ⲛⲉⲛⲭⲁⲓ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛϯⲃⲁⲕⲓ ⲛⲉⲙϩⲱⲃ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧϧⲉⲛⲛⲓⲏⲓ
bohairic_examples.translation: And they took captive all the persons of them, and all their store, and their wives, and plundered both whatever things there were in the city, and whatever things there were in the houses.

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲙⲁ ⲡⲓⲑⲱⲟⲩⲓ ⲉⲣⲁⲧⲉⲛ ⲑⲏⲛⲟⲩϧⲉⲛⲡⲥⲟⲃϯⲙⲡⲓⲉⲩⲁⲅⲅⲉⲗⲓⲟⲛ ⲛⲧⲉϯϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ
bohairic_examples.translation: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;

bohairic_examples.sentence: ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩⲟⲛ ⲛⲓⲃⲉⲛ ⲉⲧⲓⲛⲓ ⲛⲛⲓⲁⲫⲉⲣⲉⲙⲁ ⲛϩⲁⲧ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩϩⲟⲙⲧ ⲁⲩⲓⲛⲓ ⲛⲛⲓⲁⲫⲉⲣⲉⲙⲁ ⲙⲡϭⲟⲓⲥ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲩϫⲓⲙⲓ ⲛⲧⲟⲧⲟⲩ ⲛϩⲁⲛϣⲉ ⲛⲁⲧⲉⲣϩⲟⲗⲓ ⲁⲩⲓⲛⲓ ⲛⲛⲓϩⲃⲏⲟⲩⲓ ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲥⲟⲃϯ
bohairic_examples.translation: And every one that offered an offering brought silver and brass, the offerings to the Lord; and they with whom was found incorruptible wood; and they brought offerings for all the works of the preparation.
